```{r tests-clean_weight}
# A synthetic pig: linear growth plus noise, with optional spikes
make_pig <- function(id = "p1", days = 70, start = 30, adg = 0.9,
                     per_day = 8, spikes = 0, location = "101", seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  t <- sort(runif(days * per_day, 0, days))
  w <- start + adg * t + rnorm(length(t), 0, 0.5)
  if (spikes > 0) {
    idx <- round(seq(10, length(t) - 10, length.out = spikes))
    w[idx] <- w[idx] + 25
  }
  et <- as.POSIXct("2024-01-01", tz = "UTC") + t * 86400
  is_spike <- seq_along(t) %in% if (spikes > 0) idx else integer()
  data.table::data.table(
    responder = id, responder_raw = id, identified = TRUE, location = location,
    date = as.Date(et), seq_days = as.integer(as.Date(et) - as.Date("2024-01-01")) + 1L,
    entry_time = et, weight = w, is_spike = is_spike
  )
}

test_that("clean_weight runs on NEDAP and FIRE with every preset", {
  for (data in list(nedap, fire)) {
    v <- prep_visits(data, verbose = 0)
    before <- data.table::copy(v)
    for (p in c("casey", "national", "legacy")) {
      w <- clean_weight(v, qc = qc_config(p), verbose = 0)
      expect_s3_class(w, c("ppt_weight", "ppt_result"))
      expect_named(w, c("per_pig", "daily", "removed", "settings", "records"))
      expect_equal(nrow(w$per_pig), length(unique(v$responder[v$identified])))
      expect_true(all(w$per_pig$status %in% c("keep", "low_confidence", "removed")))
      expect_true(all(w$daily$responder %in% w$per_pig[status != "removed", responder]))
      expect_equal(attr(w$settings, "profile"), p)
    }
    expect_identical(v, before)
  }
})

test_that("kept pigs meet every pig-level rule", {
  qc <- qc_config()
  w <- clean_weight(prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0), verbose = 0)
  k <- w$per_pig[status != "removed"]
  expect_true(all(k$n_valid >= qc$min_records))
  expect_true(all(k$test_days >= qc$min_test_days))
  expect_true(all(k$missing_rate <= qc$max_missing_rate))
  ok_weights <- k$entry_weight <= qc$entry_weight_max & k$exit_weight >= qc$exit_weight_min
  expect_true(all(k[!ok_weights, status] == "low_confidence"))
  # the NEDAP pig with only 2 days of data is removed
  short <- w$per_pig[test_days < qc$min_test_days | n_valid < qc$min_records]
  expect_gte(nrow(short), 1L)
  expect_true(all(short$status == "removed"))
  expect_true(all(short$responder %in% w$removed$responder))
})

test_that("every outlier method finds the spikes", {
  pig <- make_pig(spikes = 6)

  for (m in c("rlm", "loess", "sd", "stl")) {

    flagged <- w$records[outlier == TRUE, weight]
    expect_true(all(spike_w %in% flagged), info = m)
    expect_lt(length(flagged), 30, label = m)
    expect_true(all(grepl(m, w$records[outlier == TRUE, qc_flag])), info = m)
  }
})

test_that("majority combination is stricter than any", {
  pig <- make_pig(spikes = 6)
  any_q <- qc_config(weight_outlier = c("rlm", "loess", "sd"), outlier_combine = "any")
  maj_q <- qc_config(weight_outlier = c("rlm", "loess", "sd"), outlier_combine = "majority")
  n_any <- sum(clean_weight(pig, any_q, verbose = 0)$records$outlier)
  n_maj <- sum(clean_weight(pig, maj_q, verbose = 0)$records$outlier)

})

test_that("weight range and optional rules flag records", {
  pig <- make_pig()
  pig$weight[c(5, 50)] <- c(5, 200)
  w <- clean_weight(pig, verbose = 0)
  expect_equal(w$records[qc_flag == "weight_range", .N], 2L)
  # daily drop: one day 20% lighter

  expect_true(all(w2$records[date == d[1], outlier]))
  expect_true(all(grepl("daily_drop", w2$records[date == d[1], qc_flag])))
  # relative deviation

  expect_false(any(grepl("rel_dev", w3$records$qc_flag)))
})

test_that("length rules remove pigs, entry/exit rules only flag them", {
  heavy <- make_pig("heavy", start = 80)          # entry weight too high
  light <- make_pig("light", start = 20, adg = 0.5, seed = 2)  # exit too low
  short <- make_pig("short", days = 20, seed = 3)  # test too short
  few <- make_pig("few", per_day = 0.2, seed = 4)  # too few records
  ok <- make_pig("ok", seed = 5)

  st <- w$per_pig[, stats::setNames(status, responder)]
  expect_equal(unname(st[c("heavy", "light", "short", "few", "ok")]),
               c("low_confidence", "low_confidence", "removed", "removed", "keep"))
  r <- w$per_pig[, stats::setNames(reason, responder)]
  expect_match(r[["heavy"]], "entry weight")

})
```

# calc_adg

`calc_adg()` estimates average daily gain (ADG) over the body weight stage
`stage_range` (default 30-120 kg):

1. a growth curve is fitted to the valid weight records of each pig
   (`curve_model`: polynomial, robust LOESS or Gompertz; Gompertz falls back
   to a quadratic curve when it does not converge);
2. the times at which the curve reaches the lower and upper stage weight
   are found, searching up to `max_extrap_days` before the first and after
   the last record;
3. ADG = weight difference / days between these two times.

Every pig gets an `adg_type`:

- `"observed"`: both stage limits are reached inside the recorded period;
- `"extrapolated"`: at least one limit needs extrapolation, but no more
  than `max_extrap_days`;
- `"partial"`: a limit is not reached even after extrapolation. ADG is then
  the mean slope of the curve over the part of the stage that is covered;
- `"none"`: less than 7 days of the stage are covered; ADG is `NA`.

```{r function-calc_adg}
#' Compute Average Daily Gain (ADG) from Growth Curves
#'
#' @description
#' Fit a growth curve to the cleaned body weights of each pig and compute
#' average daily gain (ADG) over a body weight stage.
#'
#' @param weight Result of [clean_weight()].
#' @param qc QC settings; by default the ones used by [clean_weight()].
#'   Used here: `stage_range`, `curve_model`, `loess_span`,
#'   `max_extrap_days`.
#' @param verbose 0 (silent), 1 (summary, default) or 2 (details).
#' @param cores Number of CPU cores for the per-pig computations. Default 1.
#'
#' @return An object of class `ppt_adg` (a list):
#'   - `per_pig`: one row per pig (pigs removed by [clean_weight()] are not
#'     included) with `stage`, `curve_used`, `curve_r2`, `adg_type`,
#'     `start_date` / `end_date` and `start_weight` / `end_weight` (when the
#'     curve reaches the stage limits, kg), `stage_days`,
#'     `extrap_days_start` / `extrap_days_end` (days the curve is
#'     extrapolated before the first / after the last weight), `adg` (g/d),
#'     `lm_slope` (g/d, linear regression on the records inside the stage,
#'     for comparison), `r_squared` (of that regression), `weight_status`
#'     and `weight_reason` (from [clean_weight()]);
#'   - `daily`: one row per pig and day from `start_date` to `end_date` and
#'     over the recorded days: observed `weight` (daily median, kg, `NA` on
#'     predicted days), `predicted` weight with `lower` / `upper` limits
#'     (± 1.96 residual SD), `in_stage` and `source` (`"observed"` or
#'     `"predicted"`);
#'   - `removed`: pigs removed so far, plus pigs without ADG;
#'   - `settings`: QC settings.
#'
#' @seealso [clean_weight()] for the previous step.
#' @export
calc_adg <- function(weight, qc = weight$settings, verbose = 1, cores = 1) {
  local_verbose(verbose)
  local_cores(cores)
  if (!inherits(weight, "ppt_weight")) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg weight} must be the result of {.fn clean_weight}.")
  }
  check_qc(qc)
  stage <- qc$stage_range
  ppt_msg("ADG over {stage[1]}-{stage[2]} kg ({.field {qc$curve_model}} curve)", "h1")

  kcols <- intersect(c("responder", "location", "breed", "status", "reason"), names(weight$per_pig))
  kept <- weight$per_pig[status != "removed", kcols, with = FALSE]
  data.table::setnames(kept, c("status", "reason"), c("weight_status", "weight_reason"))
  rec <- weight$records[outlier == FALSE & responder %in% kept$responder]
  day0 <- weight$daily[, min(date - seq_days + 1L)]   # date with seq_days = 1

  fits <- fit_by_pig(rec, adg_one_pig, step = "calc_adg", qc = qc, day0 = day0)
  res <- fits$result

  daily <- if (nrow(res) > 0L) {
    data.table::rbindlist(Map(function(id, d) data.table::data.table(responder = id, d),
                              res$responder, res$daily))
  } else {
    data.table::data.table()
  }
  per_pig <- if (nrow(res) > 0L) res[, !"daily"] else data.table::data.table(responder = character())
  per_pig <- merge(kept, per_pig, by = "responder", all.x = TRUE)
  per_pig[is.na(adg_type), adg_type := "none"]
  per_pig[, stage := paste0(stage[1L], "-", stage[2L])]
  if (nrow(daily) > 0L) {
    daily <- merge(kept[, .(responder, location)], daily, by = "responder")
    data.table::setcolorder(daily, c("responder", "location", "date", "seq_days"))
    data.table::setorder(daily, location, responder, date)
  }

  cols <- c("responder", "location", "breed", "stage", "curve_used", "curve_r2",
            "adg_type", "start_date", "end_date", "start_weight", "end_weight",
            "stage_days", "extrap_days_start", "extrap_days_end", "adg", "lm_slope",
            "r_squared", "weight_status",
            "weight_reason")
  per_pig <- per_pig[, intersect(cols, names(per_pig)), with = FALSE]
  data.table::setorder(per_pig, location, responder)

  no_adg <- per_pig[is.na(adg)]
  why <- fits$failed$reason[match(no_adg$responder, fits$failed$responder)]
  why[is.na(why)] <- "less than 7 days of the stage covered by the curve"
  removed <- rbind(weight$removed,
                   new_removed(no_adg$responder, no_adg$location, "calc_adg", why))

  report_adg(per_pig, fits)
  new_ppt_result(per_pig = per_pig, daily = daily, removed = removed,
                 settings = qc, class = "ppt_adg")
}

# ADG for one pig. `d` holds its valid weight records.
adg_one_pig <- function(d, qc, day0) {
  first_day <- min(d$date)
  t <- as.numeric(difftime(d$entry_time, as.POSIXct(first_day, tz = "UTC"),
                           units = "days"))
  y <- d$weight
  curve <- fit_growth_curve(t, y, qc$curve_model, qc$loess_span)

  lo <- qc$stage_range[1L]
  hi <- qc$stage_range[2L]
  tmin <- min(t)
  tmax <- max(t)
  from <- tmin - qc$max_extrap_days
  to <- tmax + qc$max_extrap_days

  t_lo <- first_cross(curve$pred, lo, from, to)
  t_hi <- first_cross(curve$pred, hi, if (is.na(t_lo)) from else t_lo, to)
  a <- if (is.na(t_lo)) tmin else t_lo
  b <- if (is.na(t_hi)) tmax else t_hi
  tol <- 0.5

  if (b - a < 7) {
    adg_type <- "none"
    adg <- NA_real_
  } else {
    adg <- (curve$pred(b) - curve$pred(a)) * 1000 / (b - a)
    adg_type <- if (is.na(t_lo) || is.na(t_hi)) {
      "partial"
    } else if (t_lo >= tmin - tol && t_hi <= tmax + tol) {
      "observed"
    } else {
      "extrapolated"
    }
  }

  # Linear regression on the records inside the stage, for comparison.
  inside <- y >= lo & y <= hi
  lm_slope <- r_squared <- NA_real_
  if (sum(inside) >= 5L && diff(range(t[inside])) >= 7) {
    lfit <- stats::lm(y[inside] ~ t[inside])
    lm_slope <- unname(stats::coef(lfit)[2L]) * 1000
    r_squared <- summary(lfit)$r.squared
  }

  # Daily table: the stage period plus the recorded days.
  obs <- d[, .(weight = stats::median(weight)), by = date]
  stage_days_idx <- if (adg_type == "none") integer() else seq(floor(a), ceiling(b) - 1)
  idx <- sort(unique(c(stage_days_idx, as.integer(obs$date - first_day))))
  dates <- first_day + idx
  pred <- curve$pred(idx + 0.5)
  daily <- data.table::data.table(
    date = dates,
    seq_days = as.integer(dates - day0) + 1L,
    weight = obs$weight[match(dates, obs$date)],
    predicted = pred,
    lower = pred - 1.96 * curve$sigma,
    upper = pred + 1.96 * curve$sigma
  )
  daily[, `:=`(
    source = data.table::fifelse(is.na(weight), "predicted", "observed"),
    in_stage = adg_type != "none" & (idx + 1) > a & idx < b
  )]

  data.table::data.table(
    curve_used = curve$name,
    curve_r2 = curve$r2,
    adg_type = adg_type,
    start_date = if (is.na(t_lo)) as.Date(NA) else first_day + floor(t_lo),
    end_date = if (is.na(t_hi)) as.Date(NA) else first_day + floor(t_hi),
    start_weight = if (adg_type == "none") NA_real_ else curve$pred(a),
    end_weight = if (adg_type == "none") NA_real_ else curve$pred(b),
    stage_days = if (adg_type == "none") NA_real_ else b - a,
    extrap_days_start = if (adg_type == "none") NA_real_ else max(0, tmin - a),
    extrap_days_end = if (adg_type == "none") NA_real_ else max(0, b - tmax),
    adg = adg,
    lm_slope = lm_slope,
    r_squared = r_squared,
    daily = list(daily)
  )
}

# Fit a growth curve. Returns a prediction function, the fitted values,
# the residual SD, R2 and the name of the model actually used.
fit_growth_curve <- function(t, y, model, span = 0.75) {
  fit_poly <- function(k, name = paste0("poly", k)) {
    f <- stats::lm(y ~ poly(t, k, raw = TRUE))
    b <- stats::coef(f)
    b[is.na(b)] <- 0                     # aliased terms, as predict() drops them
    # evaluate the polynomial directly: much faster than predict.lm()
    list(pred = function(x) as.numeric(outer(x, 0:k, `^`) %*% b),
         fitted = stats::fitted(f), name = name)
  }
  curve <- switch(model,
    poly1 = fit_poly(1),
    poly2 = fit_poly(2),
    poly3 = fit_poly(3),
    loess = {
      f <- stats::loess(y ~ t, span = span, degree = 2, family = "symmetric")
      core <- function(x) unname(stats::predict(f, newdata = data.frame(t = x)))
      rng <- range(t)
      h <- min(7, diff(rng) / 2)
      s_lo <- (core(rng[1] + h) - core(rng[1])) / h
      s_hi <- (core(rng[2]) - core(rng[2] - h)) / h
      # linear continuation of the end slopes outside the recorded range
      pred <- function(x) {
        p <- core(pmin(pmax(x, rng[1]), rng[2]))
        p + pmin(x - rng[1], 0) * s_lo + pmax(x - rng[2], 0) * s_hi
      }
      list(pred = pred, fitted = stats::fitted(f), name = "loess")
    },
    gompertz = {
      f <- tryCatch(stats::nls(y ~ stats::SSgompertz(t, Asym, b2, b3)),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(f)) {
        fit_poly(2, "poly2 (gompertz failed)")
      } else {
        list(pred = function(x) as.numeric(stats::predict(f, newdata = data.frame(t = x))),
             fitted = as.numeric(stats::fitted(f)), name = "gompertz")
      }
    }
  )
  res <- y - curve$fitted
  curve$sigma <- stats::sd(res)
  curve$r2 <- 1 - sum(res^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)
  curve
}

# First time in [from, to] at which `pred` rises to `target`. NA if the
# curve is already above the target at `from` or never reaches it.
first_cross <- function(pred, target, from, to, step = 0.1) {
  if (to <= from) return(NA_real_)
  g <- seq(from, to, by = step)
  p <- pred(g)
  i <- which(p >= target)[1L]
  if (is.na(i) || i == 1L) return(NA_real_)
  g[i - 1L] + (target - p[i - 1L]) / (p[i] - p[i - 1L]) * step
}

report_adg <- function(per_pig, fits) {
  types <- table(factor(per_pig$adg_type,
                        levels = c("observed", "extrapolated", "partial", "none")))
  ppt_bullets_counts(c(
    "Observed (stage inside the records)" = types[["observed"]],
    "Extrapolated" = types[["extrapolated"]],
    "Partial (stage not fully reached)" = types[["partial"]],
    "No ADG" = types[["none"]]
  ))
  fallback <- per_pig[grepl("failed", curve_used), .N]
  if (fallback > 0L) {
    ppt_msg("Gompertz did not converge for {fallback} pig{?s}: quadratic curve used", "warning")
  }
  if (types[["partial"]] > 0L) {
    ppt_warn("{types[['partial']]} pig{?s} {?does/do} not reach the whole stage: ADG is based on part of it (adg_type = \"partial\").")
  }
  if (any(!is.na(per_pig$adg))) {
    ppt_msg("Mean ADG: {round(mean(per_pig$adg, na.rm = TRUE))} g/d (SD {round(stats::sd(per_pig$adg, na.rm = TRUE))})", "success")
  }
  for (i in which(per_pig$adg_type != "observed")) {
    ppt_msg("{.val {per_pig$responder[i]}}: {per_pig$adg_type[i]}, ADG {round(per_pig$adg[i])} g/d", "info", level = 2L)
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r example-calc_adg}
visits <- prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0)
w <- clean_weight(visits, verbose = 0)
adg <- calc_adg(w)
head(adg$per_pig[, .(responder, adg_type, start_date, end_date, stage_days, adg)])

# Gompertz curve, with quadratic fallback
adg_g <- calc_adg(w, qc = qc_config("casey", curve_model = "gompertz"), verbose = 0)
table(adg_g$per_pig$curve_used)
```

```{r tests-calc_adg}
# Linear pig: y = start + rate * t (kg), weights recorded from day 0 to `days`
line_pig <- function(id = "p1", start = 30, rate = 1, days = 95, noise = 0.3,
                     seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  t <- seq(0.3, days, by = 0.25)
  w <- start + rate * t + rnorm(length(t), 0, noise)
  et <- as.POSIXct("2024-01-01", tz = "UTC") + t * 86400
  data.table::data.table(
    responder = id, responder_raw = id, identified = TRUE, location = "101",
    date = as.Date(et), seq_days = as.integer(as.Date(et) - as.Date("2024-01-01")) + 1L,
    entry_time = et, weight = w
  )
}
no_checks <- function(...) {
  qc_config(min_test_days = 7, min_records = 5, max_missing_rate = 1, ...)
}

test_that("a perfectly linear pig gives the exact ADG", {
  for (m in c("poly1", "poly2", "poly3", "loess")) {
    w <- clean_weight(line_pig(), qc = no_checks(curve_model = m), verbose = 0)
    a <- calc_adg(w, verbose = 0)$per_pig
    expect_equal(a$adg, 1000, tolerance = 0.01, info = m)
    expect_equal(a$adg_type, "observed", info = m)
    expect_equal(a$stage_days, 90, tolerance = 0.02, info = m)
    expect_equal(a$lm_slope, 1000, tolerance = 0.01, info = m)
  }
})

test_that("extrapolation and partial stages are flagged", {
  q <- no_checks()
  # records from 40 to 110 kg: both limits reached within 10 days
  ext <- calc_adg(clean_weight(line_pig(start = 40, days = 70), q, verbose = 0), verbose = 0)$per_pig
  expect_equal(ext$adg_type, "extrapolated")
  expect_equal(ext$adg, 1000, tolerance = 0.01)
  # records from 30 to 70 kg: 120 kg is 50 days away (> max_extrap_days)
  part <- suppressWarnings(calc_adg(clean_weight(line_pig(days = 40), q, verbose = 0), verbose = 0))$per_pig
  expect_equal(part$adg_type, "partial")
  expect_equal(part$adg, 1000, tolerance = 0.01)
  expect_true(is.na(part$end_date))
  expect_message(calc_adg(clean_weight(line_pig(days = 40), q, verbose = 0), verbose = 1), "partial")
  # a larger extrapolation window turns it into "extrapolated"
  q60 <- no_checks(max_extrap_days = 60)
  ext60 <- calc_adg(clean_weight(line_pig(days = 40), q60, verbose = 0), verbose = 0)$per_pig
  expect_equal(ext60$adg_type, "extrapolated")
})

test_that("daily table covers the stage and the records", {
  w <- clean_weight(line_pig(start = 40, days = 70), no_checks(), verbose = 0)
  a <- calc_adg(w, verbose = 0)
  d <- a$daily
  expect_setequal(names(d), c("responder", "location", "date", "seq_days", "weight",
                              "predicted", "lower", "upper", "source", "in_stage"))
  expect_true(all(d[in_stage == TRUE, predicted] >= 29 & d[in_stage == TRUE, predicted] <= 121))
  expect_equal(sum(d$in_stage), 90, tolerance = 1)
  expect_true(all(d[source == "predicted", is.na(weight)]))
  expect_lt(min(d$date), min(w$records$date))     # extrapolated backwards
})

test_that("calc_adg works on both datasets and every curve", {
  for (data in list(nedap, fire)) {
    w <- clean_weight(prep_visits(data, verbose = 0), verbose = 0)
    for (m in c("poly2", "loess", "gompertz")) {
      a <- suppressWarnings(calc_adg(w, qc = qc_config(curve_model = m), verbose = 0))
      expect_s3_class(a, c("ppt_adg", "ppt_result"))
      expect_equal(nrow(a$per_pig), w$per_pig[status != "removed", .N])
      ok <- a$per_pig[!is.na(adg)]
      expect_true(all(ok$adg > 300 & ok$adg < 2000), info = m)
      expect_true(all(a$per_pig$adg_type %in% c("observed", "extrapolated", "partial", "none")))
    }
  }
})

test_that("Gompertz falls back to a quadratic curve when nls fails", {
  # a straight line has no Gompertz shape
  w <- clean_weight(line_pig(), no_checks(curve_model = "gompertz"), verbose = 0)
  a <- calc_adg(w, verbose = 0)$per_pig
  expect_match(a$curve_used, "gompertz")
  expect_equal(a$adg, 1000, tolerance = 0.05)
  # force a failure: a flat series has no Gompertz shape
  curve <- fit_growth_curve(0:9, rep(50, 10), "gompertz")
  expect_equal(curve$name, "poly2 (gompertz failed)")
})

test_that("pigs with too little of the stage get no ADG and are logged", {
  late <- line_pig("late", start = 115, days = 20)    # only 115-135 kg
  ok <- line_pig("ok", seed = 2)
  w <- clean_weight(rbind(late, ok), no_checks(weight_range = c(15, 150)), verbose = 0)
  a <- calc_adg(w, verbose = 0)
  expect_equal(a$per_pig[responder == "late", adg_type], "none")
  expect_true(is.na(a$per_pig[responder == "late", adg]))
  expect_true("late" %in% a$removed[step == "calc_adg", responder])
  expect_equal(a$per_pig[responder == "ok", adg_type], "observed")
})

test_that("bad inputs are rejected", {
  expect_error(calc_adg(list()), "clean_weight")
})
```

# flag_feed_errors

`flag_feed_errors()` applies the 16 error criteria of Casey et al. (2005,
Table 3) to every visit.

The seven variables are computed on the **complete visit sequence of each
feeder**, including unidentified visits, sorted by entrance time:

- FIV = feed intake per visit (g), OTV = occupation time (s),
  FRV = FIV / (OTV / 60) (g/min, not computed when OTV <= 0);
- LWD = trough weight at entrance of the following visit - at exit of
  this visit; FWD = trough weight at entrance of this visit - at exit of the
  preceding visit (FIRE only, NEDAP has no trough weights);
- LTD = entrance time of the following visit - exit time of this visit;
  FTD = entrance time of this visit - exit time of the preceding visit.

| # | Error | Visits considered | Threshold (default) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | FIV-lo | all | FIV < -20 g |
| 2 | FIV-hi | all | FIV > 2000 g |
| 3 | FIV-0 | OTV = 0 | \|FIV\| > 20 g |
| 4 | OTV-lo | all | OTV < 0 s |
| 5 | OTV-hi | all | OTV > 3600 s |
| 6 | FRV-hi-FIV-lo | 0 < FIV < 50 g | FRV > 500 g/min |
| 7 | FRV-hi-strict | FIV >= 50 g, preceding or following visit FIV < -20 g | FRV > 110 g/min |
| 8 | FRV-hi | FIV >= 50 g, neither neighbour FIV < -20 g | FRV > 170 g/min |
| 9 | FRV-0 | FRV = 0 | OTV > 500 s |
| 10 | FRV-lo | FRV != 0 | \|FRV\| <= 2 g/min |
| 11-12 | LWD-lo / LWD-hi | all but the last visit on the feeder | LWD < -20 g / > 1800 g |
| 13-14 | FWD-lo / FWD-hi | all but the first visit on the feeder | FWD < -20 g / > 1800 g |
| 15 | LTD-lo | all but the last visit | LTD < 0 s |
| 16 | FTD-lo | all but the first visit | FTD < 0 s |

The thresholds come from [qc_config()]. Feed disappearance in unidentified
visits (-20 g <= FIV <= 2000 g) is summed per feeder; Casey et al. discarded
pens above 90 kg, here a warning is given above `max_unidentified_feed_kg`.

```{r function-flag_feed_errors}
#' Flag Feeder Errors (Casey et al. 2005)
#'
#' @description
#' Flag each visit with the 16 error types of Casey et al. (2005).
#'
#' @param visits Visit table from [prep_visits()]. Keep the unidentified
#'   visits: they are part of the feeder sequence.
#' @param qc QC settings from [qc_config()]. Used here: `fiv_range`,
#'   `fiv0_abs_max`, `duration_max`, `speed_fiv_lo_max`,
#'   `speed_strict_max`, `speed_range`, `idle_duration_max`,
#'   `trough_diff_range`, `max_unidentified_feed_kg`, `fiv_max_by_weight`.
#' @param bw Optional daily body weight of each pig, used to look up
#'   `fiv_max_by_weight`: a data frame with `responder`, `date` and `bw`
#'   (kg), such as the fitted weights of [calc_adg()]. [calc_adfi()] passes
#'   them automatically. Without it, the daily median of the recorded
#'   weights is used; early in the test these are often biased upwards by
#'   outliers.
#' @param verbose 0 (silent), 1 (summary, default) or 2 (rate of each
#'   error type).
#'
#' @return The visit table (all visits) with added columns:
#'   - `fiv`, `otv`, `frv`, `lwd`, `fwd`, `ltd`, `ftd`: the seven
#'     variables;
#'   - one logical column per error type (`fiv_lo`, `fiv_hi`, `fiv_0`,
#'     `otv_lo`, `otv_hi`, `frv_hi_fiv_lo`, `frv_hi_strict`, `frv_hi`,
#'     `frv_0`, `frv_lo`, `lwd_lo`, `lwd_hi`, `fwd_lo`, `fwd_hi`, `ltd_lo`,
#'     `ftd_lo`);
#'   - `fiv_max`: the FIV-hi limit used for the visit (g), fixed or from
#'     `fiv_max_by_weight`;
#'   - `n_errors`: number of error types of the visit (0 = error-free).
#'
#'   Attributes `"feeders"` (per feeder: visits, unidentified visits, feed
#'   disappearance in unidentified visits, error rate) and `"error_rates"`
#'   (share of identified visits with each error type) summarise the
#'   result. The attributes of `visits` are kept.
#'
#' @references
#' Casey, D. S., Stern, H. S., & Dekkers, J. C. M. (2005). Identification of
#' errors and factors associated with errors in data from electronic swine
#' feeders. *Journal of Animal Science*, 83, 969-982.
#'
#' @seealso [prep_visits()] for the previous step, [calc_adfi()] which uses
#'   the flags.
#' @export
flag_feed_errors <- function(visits, qc = qc_config(), bw = NULL, verbose = 1) {
  local_verbose(verbose)
  check_qc(qc)
  dt <- as_dt(visits, "visits")
  check_cols(dt, c("responder", "identified", "location", "entry_time",
                   "exit_time", "duration", "feed_intake", "trough_in",
                   "trough_out"),
             arg = "visits", hint = "Use {.fn prep_visits} first.")
  ppt_msg("Flagging feeder errors (Casey et al. 2005)", "h1")
  if (dt[identified == FALSE, .N] == 0L) {
    ppt_msg("No unidentified visits in the data: if they were removed before, differences between subsequent visits may be wrong", "warning", level = 2L)
  }

  data.table::setorder(dt, location, entry_time)

  # The seven variables, on the complete sequence of each feeder.
  dt[, `:=`(fiv = feed_intake, otv = duration)]
  dt[, frv := data.table::fifelse(otv > 0, fiv / (otv / 60), NA_real_)]
  dt[, `:=`(
    prev_fiv = data.table::shift(fiv),
    next_fiv = data.table::shift(fiv, type = "lead"),
    lwd = data.table::shift(trough_in, type = "lead") - trough_out,
    fwd = trough_in - data.table::shift(trough_out),
    ltd = as.numeric(data.table::shift(entry_time, type = "lead") - exit_time, units = "secs"),
    ftd = as.numeric(entry_time - data.table::shift(exit_time), units = "secs")
  ), by = location]

  fiv_lo <- qc$fiv_range[1L]
  is_true <- function(x) x %in% TRUE
  # upper limit of FIV: fixed, or by body weight (and breed)
  dt[, fiv_max := if (is.null(qc$fiv_max_by_weight)) qc$fiv_range[2L] else fiv_limit_by_weight(dt, qc, bw)]
  neighbour_neg <- dt[, is_true(prev_fiv < fiv_lo) | is_true(next_fiv < fiv_lo)]
  dt[, `:=`(
    fiv_lo = is_true(fiv < fiv_lo),
    fiv_hi = is_true(fiv > fiv_max),
    fiv_0 = is_true(otv == 0 & abs(fiv) > qc$fiv0_abs_max),
    otv_lo = is_true(otv < 0),
    otv_hi = is_true(otv > qc$duration_max),
    frv_hi_fiv_lo = is_true(fiv > 0 & fiv < 50 & frv > qc$speed_fiv_lo_max),
    frv_hi_strict = is_true(fiv >= 50 & neighbour_neg & frv > qc$speed_strict_max),
    frv_hi = is_true(fiv >= 50 & !neighbour_neg & frv > qc$speed_range[2L]),
    frv_0 = is_true(frv == 0 & otv > qc$idle_duration_max),
    frv_lo = is_true(frv != 0 & abs(frv) <= qc$speed_range[1L]),
    lwd_lo = is_true(lwd < qc$trough_diff_range[1L]),
    lwd_hi = is_true(lwd > qc$trough_diff_range[2L]),
    fwd_lo = is_true(fwd < qc$trough_diff_range[1L]),
    fwd_hi = is_true(fwd > qc$trough_diff_range[2L]),
    ltd_lo = is_true(ltd < 0),
    ftd_lo = is_true(ftd < 0)
  )]
  errs <- error_types()
  dt[, n_errors := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = names(errs)]
  dt[, c("prev_fiv", "next_fiv") := NULL]

  # Summaries
  feeders <- dt[, .(
    n_visits = .N,
    n_unidentified = sum(!identified),
    unidentified_feed_kg = sum(fiv[!identified & fiv >= fiv_lo & fiv <= qc$fiv_range[2L]],
                               na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
    error_rate = mean(n_errors[identified] > 0)
  ), by = location]
  idv <- dt[identified == TRUE]
  rates <- data.table::data.table(
    index = unname(errs),
    error = names(errs),
    label = error_labels()[names(errs)],
    n = vapply(names(errs), function(e) sum(idv[[e]]), numeric(1)),
    rate = vapply(names(errs), function(e) mean(idv[[e]]), numeric(1))
  )

  for (a in c("station", "stations", "removed", "prep_summary")) {
    data.table::setattr(dt, a, attr(visits, a, exact = TRUE))
  }
  data.table::setattr(dt, "feeders", feeders)
  data.table::setattr(dt, "error_rates", rates)

  oe <- mean(idv$n_errors > 0)
  ppt_msg("Visits with at least one error: {.strong {sprintf('%.2f%%', 100 * oe)}} of {nrow(idv)} identified visits", "info")
  top <- rates[n > 0][order(-n)]
  if (nrow(top) > 0L) {
    lines <- sprintf("%s: %d (%.2f%%)", top$label, as.integer(top$n), 100 * top$rate)
    ppt_msg(stats::setNames(lines, rep("*", length(lines))), "bullets", level = 2L)
  }
  big <- feeders[unidentified_feed_kg > qc$max_unidentified_feed_kg]
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(big))) {
    ppt_warn("Feeder {.val {big$location[i]}}: {round(big$unidentified_feed_kg[i], 1)} kg of feed disappeared in unidentified visits (> {qc$max_unidentified_feed_kg} kg). Casey et al. (2005) discarded such pens.")
  }
  dt
}

# Body weight of the pig at each visit: from `bw` (daily fitted weights)
# when given, otherwise the daily median of the valid recorded weights;
# interpolated between days. NA for unidentified visits.
visit_body_weight <- function(dt, qc, bw = NULL) {
  day <- as.numeric(as.Date(dt$entry_time, tz = "UTC"))
  if (!is.null(bw)) {
    bw <- data.table::as.data.table(bw)
    check_cols(bw, c("responder", "date", "bw"), arg = "bw")
    daily <- bw[!is.na(bw), .(responder = as.character(responder),
                              day = as.numeric(as.Date(date)), w = bw)]
  } else {
    ok <- dt$identified & !is.na(dt$weight) &
      dt$weight >= qc$weight_range[1L] & dt$weight <= qc$weight_range[2L]
    daily <- data.table::data.table(responder = dt$responder[ok], day = day[ok],
                                    w = dt$weight[ok])
  }
  daily <- daily[, .(w = stats::median(w)), by = .(responder, day)]
  out <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(dt))
  for (pig in unique(daily$responder)) {
    d <- daily[responder == pig][order(day)]
    idx <- which(dt$identified & dt$responder %in% pig)
    out[idx] <- if (nrow(d) == 1L) d$w else stats::approx(d$day, d$w, xout = day[idx], rule = 2)$y
  }
  out
}

# FIV-hi limit of each visit from the table qc$fiv_max_by_weight.
# Visits without body weight, or of a breed absent from the table, keep the
# fixed limit fiv_range[2].
fiv_limit_by_weight <- function(dt, qc, bw_table = NULL) {
  tab <- data.table::as.data.table(qc$fiv_max_by_weight)
  bw <- visit_body_weight(dt, qc, bw_table)
  lim <- rep(qc$fiv_range[2L], nrow(dt))
  pick <- function(rows, t) {
    t <- t[order(weight_from)]
    k <- findInterval(bw[rows], t$weight_from)
    k[k == 0L] <- 1L
    ifelse(is.na(bw[rows]), qc$fiv_range[2L], t$fiv_max[k])
  }
  if ("breed" %in% names(tab)) {
    visit_breed <- if ("breed" %in% names(dt)) as.character(dt$breed) else rep(NA_character_, nrow(dt))
    for (b in unique(stats::na.omit(tab$breed))) {
      rows <- which(visit_breed %in% b)
      if (length(rows)) lim[rows] <- pick(rows, tab[breed %in% b])
    }
    default <- tab[is.na(breed)]
    rows <- which(!visit_breed %in% tab$breed)
    if (nrow(default) > 0L && length(rows)) lim[rows] <- pick(rows, default)
  } else {
    lim <- pick(seq_len(nrow(dt)), tab)
  }
  lim
}

# Error types in the order of Casey et al. (2005), Table 3.
error_types <- function() {
  c(fiv_lo = 1L, fiv_hi = 2L, fiv_0 = 3L, otv_lo = 4L, otv_hi = 5L,
    frv_hi_fiv_lo = 6L, frv_hi_strict = 7L, frv_hi = 8L, frv_0 = 9L,
    frv_lo = 10L, lwd_lo = 11L, lwd_hi = 12L, fwd_lo = 13L, fwd_hi = 14L,
    ltd_lo = 15L, ftd_lo = 16L)
}

error_labels <- function() {
  c(fiv_lo = "FIV-lo", fiv_hi = "FIV-hi", fiv_0 = "FIV-0", otv_lo = "OTV-lo",
    otv_hi = "OTV-hi", frv_hi_fiv_lo = "FRV-hi-FIV-lo",
    frv_hi_strict = "FRV-hi-strict", frv_hi = "FRV-hi", frv_0 = "FRV-0",
    frv_lo = "FRV-lo", lwd_lo = "LWD-lo", lwd_hi = "LWD-hi",
    fwd_lo = "FWD-lo", fwd_hi = "FWD-hi", ltd_lo = "LTD-lo", ftd_lo = "FTD-lo")
}

# Daily covariates of Jiao et al. (2014) for each pig and day, from the
# identified visits of a flagged visit table:
# - y: error-free daily feed intake (sum of FIV over visits without error);
# - pte_<error>: share of the day's visits with that error (16);
# - otd_<error>: occupation time of visits with that error (types 1, 2, 6-14);
# - fid_<error>: feed intake of visits with that error (types 4, 5, 15, 16).
daily_error_covariates <- function(flagged) {
  errs <- names(error_types())
  otd_errs <- errs[error_types() %in% c(1:2, 6:14)]
  fid_errs <- errs[error_types() %in% c(4:5, 15:16)]
  cols <- c("responder", "date", "location", "fiv", "otv", "n_errors", errs)
  idv <- flagged[identified == TRUE, cols, with = FALSE]

  # per-visit numeric columns, then one grouped sum/mean each (GForce, fast)
  idv[, `:=`(error_free = as.numeric(n_errors == 0L), error_visit = as.numeric(n_errors > 0L))]
  idv[, y_part := fiv * error_free]
  pte <- paste0("pte_", errs)
  otd <- paste0("otd_", otd_errs)
  fid <- paste0("fid_", fid_errs)
  idv[, (pte) := lapply(.SD, as.numeric), .SDcols = errs]
  idv[, (otd) := lapply(.SD, function(e) otv * e), .SDcols = otd_errs]
  idv[, (fid) := lapply(.SD, function(e) fiv * e), .SDcols = fid_errs]

  keys <- c("responder", "date")
  out <- idv[, .(n_visits = .N, n_error_visits = sum(error_visit),
                 dfi_raw = sum(fiv), y = sum(y_part)), by = keys]
  out[, n_error_visits := as.integer(n_error_visits)]
  m <- idv[, lapply(.SD, mean), by = keys, .SDcols = pte]
  sm <- idv[, lapply(.SD, sum), by = keys, .SDcols = c(otd, fid)]
  # station of the day: the one with most visits
  loc <- idv[, .N, by = c(keys, "location")]
  data.table::setorderv(loc, c(keys, "N", "location"), c(1L, 1L, -1L, 1L))
  loc <- loc[, .(location = location[1L]), by = keys]

  out <- Reduce(function(x, z) x[z, on = keys], list(out, loc, m, sm))
  data.table::setcolorder(out, c(keys, "location", "n_visits", "n_error_visits", "dfi_raw", "y"))
  data.table::setorderv(out, keys)
  out[]
}
```

```{r tests-flag_feed_errors}
# Visits on one feeder, built from entrance/exit seconds and trough weights
feeder_visits <- function(id, entry, exit, w_in, w_out, location = "101") {
  base <- as.POSIXct("2024-01-01", tz = "UTC")
  data.table::data.table(
    responder = id, identified = !is.na(id), location = location,
    entry_time = base + entry, exit_time = base + exit,
    duration = exit - entry, feed_intake = w_in - w_out,
    trough_in = w_in, trough_out = w_out
  )
}

test_that("variables match Casey et al. (2005) Table 2", {
  v <- feeder_visits(c("2736", "1340", "598"),
                     entry = c(756041, 756605, 757288),
                     exit = c(756570, 757250, 758153),
                     w_in = c(7044, 6856, 7066), w_out = c(6856, 6657, 6763))
  f <- flag_feed_errors(v, verbose = 0)
  expect_equal(f$fiv, c(188, 199, 303))
  expect_equal(f$otv, c(529, 645, 865))
  expect_equal(round(f$frv, 1), c(21.3, 18.5, 21.0))
  expect_equal(f$lwd, c(0, 409, NA))
  expect_equal(f$fwd, c(NA, 0, 409))
  expect_equal(f$ltd, c(35, 38, NA))
  expect_equal(f$ftd, c(NA, 35, 38))
  expect_equal(f$n_errors, c(0, 0, 0))
})

test_that("each rule fires on a constructed visit", {
  # one feeder, visits 1000 s apart; trough weights consistent unless changed
  n <- 12
  entry <- seq(0, by = 1000, length.out = n)
  exit <- entry + 300
  fi <- rep(100, n)
  w_in <- 1000 + 0 * seq_len(n)
  v <- feeder_visits(as.character(seq_len(n)), entry, exit, w_in, w_in - fi)
  v[2, feed_intake := -30]                    # FIV-lo
  v[3, feed_intake := 2500]                   # FIV-hi
  v[4, `:=`(duration = 0, exit_time = entry_time, feed_intake = 30)]  # FIV-0
  v[5, duration := 4000]                      # OTV-hi
  v[6, `:=`(feed_intake = 40, duration = 3)]  # FRV-hi-FIV-lo (800 g/min)
  v[7, `:=`(feed_intake = 600, duration = 200)] # FRV-hi (180 g/min)
  v[8, `:=`(feed_intake = 0, duration = 600)] # FRV-0
  v[9, `:=`(feed_intake = 5, duration = 600)] # FRV-lo (0.5 g/min)
  f <- flag_feed_errors(v, verbose = 0)
  expect_true(f$fiv_lo[2])
  expect_true(f$fiv_hi[3])
  expect_true(f$fiv_0[4])
  expect_true(f$otv_hi[5])
  expect_true(f$frv_hi_fiv_lo[6])
  expect_true(f$frv_hi[7])
  expect_true(f$frv_0[8])
  expect_true(f$frv_lo[9])
  # visit 1 and 3 neighbour visit 2 (FIV < -20): strict rule, not FRV-hi
  v2 <- data.table::copy(v)
  v2[3, `:=`(feed_intake = 600, duration = 300)]   # 120 g/min
  f2 <- flag_feed_errors(v2, verbose = 0)
  expect_true(f2$frv_hi_strict[3])
  expect_false(f2$frv_hi[3])
  # same rate without a negative neighbour is below the FRV-hi threshold
  expect_false(f2$frv_hi_strict[7])
  # OTV <= 0: FRV not computed
  expect_true(is.na(f$frv[4]))
})

test_that("trough weight differences flag both neighbours", {
  # a exits at 900 g, b enters at 3000 g (+2100), c enters at 850 g after b left 2900 g
  v <- feeder_visits(c("a", "b", "c"), entry = c(0, 1000, 2000),
                     exit = c(500, 1500, 2500), w_in = c(1000, 3000, 850),
                     w_out = c(900, 2900, 800))
  f <- flag_feed_errors(v, verbose = 0)
  expect_equal(f$lwd, c(2100, -2050, NA))
  expect_equal(f$fwd, c(NA, 2100, -2050))
  expect_equal(f$lwd_hi, c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE))
  expect_equal(f$fwd_hi, c(FALSE, TRUE, FALSE))
  expect_equal(f$lwd_lo, c(FALSE, TRUE, FALSE))
  expect_equal(f$fwd_lo, c(FALSE, FALSE, TRUE))
})

test_that("time overlaps are flagged as LTD-lo / FTD-lo", {
  v <- feeder_visits(c("a", "b"), entry = c(0, 400), exit = c(500, 800),
                     w_in = c(1000, 900), w_out = c(900, 800))
  f <- flag_feed_errors(v, verbose = 0)
  expect_true(f$ltd_lo[1])
  expect_true(f$ftd_lo[2])
  expect_false(f$ltd_lo[2])
})

test_that("FIRE example: rates as computed from the paper's criteria", {
  f <- flag_feed_errors(prep_visits(fire, verbose = 0), verbose = 0)
  idv <- f[identified == TRUE]
  expect_equal(nrow(idv), 9743L)
  expect_equal(round(100 * mean(idv$n_errors > 0), 2), 2.62)
  expect_equal(round(100 * mean(idv$frv_hi_strict), 2), 0.04)
  expect_equal(nrow(f), nrow(fire))       # unidentified visits kept
  fd <- attr(f, "feeders")
  expect_equal(sum(fd$n_unidentified), 51L)
  expect_lt(max(fd$unidentified_feed_kg), 90)
})

test_that("feeders are processed separately", {
  v <- prep_visits(fire, verbose = 0)
  all <- flag_feed_errors(v, verbose = 0)
  one <- flag_feed_errors(v[location == "101"], verbose = 0)
  two <- flag_feed_errors(v[location == "102"], verbose = 0)
  cols <- c("location", "entry_time", "lwd", "fwd", "ltd", "ftd", names(error_types()))
  for (cl in cols) expect_equal(all[[cl]], rbind(one, two)[[cl]], info = cl)
})

test_that("NEDAP: weight differences are NA, time rules still apply", {
  f <- flag_feed_errors(prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0), verbose = 0)
  expect_true(all(is.na(f$lwd)) && all(is.na(f$fwd)))
  expect_false(any(f$lwd_lo | f$fwd_hi))
  expect_true(any(!is.na(f$ltd)))
})

test_that("FIV-hi limit can depend on body weight and breed", {
  v <- prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0)
  fixed <- flag_feed_errors(v, verbose = 0)
  expect_true(all(fixed$fiv_max == 2000))
  # one limit for all weights: same as a fixed limit
  flat <- flag_feed_errors(v, qc_config(fiv_max_by_weight = data.frame(weight_from = 0, fiv_max = 500)), verbose = 0)
  idv <- flat[identified == TRUE & !is.na(weight)]
  expect_true(all(flat[identified == FALSE, fiv_max] == 2000))
  expect_equal(sum(flat$fiv_hi), flat[, sum(feed_intake > fiv_max)])
  expect_gt(sum(flat$fiv_hi), sum(fixed$fiv_hi))
  # limit rising with weight: light pigs get the lower limit
  tab <- data.frame(weight_from = c(0, 60), fiv_max = c(300, 5000))
  byw <- flag_feed_errors(v, qc_config(fiv_max_by_weight = tab), verbose = 0)
  expect_setequal(unique(byw[identified == TRUE, fiv_max]), c(300, 5000))
  # breed-specific table: breeds absent from the table keep 2000 g
  pigs <- unique(v[identified == TRUE, responder])
  vb <- add_breed(v, data.frame(responder = pigs, breed = rep(c("DD", "ZZ"), length.out = length(pigs))), verbose = 0)
  fb <- flag_feed_errors(vb, qc_config(fiv_max_by_weight = fiv_max_example()), verbose = 0)
  expect_true(all(fb[breed == "ZZ", fiv_max] == 2000))
  expect_true(all(fb[breed == "DD", fiv_max] %in% fiv_max_example()[breed == "DD", fiv_max]))
  # fitted body weights can be supplied
  bwt <- data.table::data.table(responder = pigs, date = min(v$date), bw = 25)
  f25 <- flag_feed_errors(v, qc_config(fiv_max_by_weight = tab), bw = bwt, verbose = 0)
  expect_true(all(f25[identified == TRUE, fiv_max] == 300))
  expect_error(flag_feed_errors(v, qc_config(fiv_max_by_weight = tab), bw = data.frame(x = 1), verbose = 0), "bw")
})

test_that("a large unidentified feed disappearance gives a warning", {
  v <- prep_visits(fire, verbose = 0)

  expect_message(flag_feed_errors(v, q, verbose = 1), "unidentified")
})

test_that("daily covariates follow Jiao et al. (2014)", {
  f <- flag_feed_errors(prep_visits(fire, verbose = 0), verbose = 0)
  cv <- daily_error_covariates(f)
  expect_equal(sum(startsWith(names(cv), "pte_")), 16L)
  expect_equal(sum(startsWith(names(cv), "otd_")), 11L)
  expect_equal(sum(startsWith(names(cv), "fid_")), 4L)
  expect_true(all(cv$y <= cv$dfi_raw + 1e-9 | cv$n_error_visits > 0))
  expect_equal(cv[n_error_visits == 0, y], cv[n_error_visits == 0, dfi_raw])
  expect_equal(sum(cv$dfi_raw), f[identified == TRUE, sum(fiv)])
})
```

# calc_adfi

`calc_adfi()` estimates average daily feed intake (ADFI) over the same body
weight stage as [calc_adg()], so that FCR compares like with like.

**Correction** (Jiao et al. 2014, after Casey et al. 2005): for each pig and
day, the error-free intake `y` (sum of FIV over visits without error) is
modelled with a linear mixed model fitted on **all** pig-days:

`y ~ location + breed + BW + ADG + 16 x PTE + 11 x OTD + 4 x FID + (1 | pig)`

- PTE: share of the day's visits with error type p; OTD: occupation time
  of visits with error p (types 1, 2, 6-14); FID: feed intake of visits
  with error p (types 4, 5, 15, 16);
- BW: predicted body weight of the day from [calc_adg()]; ADG of the pig;
- `location` is a fixed effect when there is more than one station, and
  `breed` when the data have a `breed` column (see [add_breed()]) with
  more than one breed.

The corrected intake is `y - sum(b x error covariates)`: only the effects
of the error covariates are removed, so a day without errors keeps its
recorded intake. Covariates without variation or perfectly collinear with
others are dropped before fitting. Days on which every visit has an error
have no error-free intake and are imputed.

**Checks and imputation** over the stage days of each pig:

- corrected intake below 0, outside `dfi_range`, or outside the optional
  `dfi_quantile` limits is set to missing;
- `impute_method = "linear"` (default): linear interpolation inside the
  recorded period (`"iii"`), robust LOESS for gaps longer than
  `long_gap_days`, and a per-pig regression of intake on body weight
  outside the recorded period (`"elrp"`);
- `impute_method = "loess"`: a robust LOESS of daily intake over days,
  used both inside and outside the recorded period.

A simulation on the example data (random gaps, long gaps, late entry,
early exit) found no curve better than the others in every situation:
precision depends mainly on how many days are missing at the stage ends,
which is why such pigs are flagged by [calc_fcr()].

Day states: `"org"` (no error, recorded value), `"corr"` (corrected),
`"iii"` (interpolated), `"elrp"` (extrapolated), `"missing"`.

```{r function-calc_adfi}
#' Correct and Impute Daily Feed Intake (ADFI)
#'
#' @description
#' Correct daily feed intake for feeder errors with a linear mixed model,
#' impute missing days and compute average daily feed intake (ADFI) over
#' the ADG stage.
#'
#' @param visits Visit table from [prep_visits()], or already flagged by
#'   [flag_feed_errors()].
#' @param adg Result of [calc_adg()].
#' @param qc QC settings; by default the ones used for `adg`. Used here:
#'   the feeder error thresholds, `dfi_correct`, `dfi_range`,
#'   `dfi_quantile`, `impute_method`, `long_gap_days`, `loess_span`.
#' @param verbose 0 (silent), 1 (summary, default) or 2 (details).
#' @param cores Number of CPU cores for the per-pig computations. Default 1.
#'
#' @return An object of class `ppt_adfi` (a list):
#'   - `per_pig`: `adfi` (g/d over the stage), `adfi_raw` (mean recorded
#'     intake of the recorded stage days), `adfi_error_free`,
#'     `n_stage_days`, `n_observed`, `n_corrected`, `n_interpolated`,
#'     `n_extrapolated`, `n_missing`, `n_extrap_start` / `n_extrap_end`
#'     (consecutive extrapolated days at the start / end of the stage),
#'     `coverage` (share of stage days with a
#'     recorded or corrected value), `adg_type`;
#'   - `daily`: one row per pig and day: `bw` (kg), `in_stage`,
#'     `n_visits`, `n_error_visits`, `dfi_raw`, `dfi_error_free`,
#'     `dfi_corrected`, `dfi` (final value, g) and `state`;
#'   - `model`: fixed-effect estimates of the correction model;
#'   - `removed`, `settings`.
#'
#' @references
#' Jiao, S., Maltecca, C., Gray, K. A., & Cassady, J. P. (2014). Feed intake,
#' average daily gain, feed efficiency, and real-time ultrasound traits in
#' Duroc pigs: I. *Journal of Animal Science*, 92, 2377-2386.
#'
#' @seealso [flag_feed_errors()], [calc_adg()].
#' @export
calc_adfi <- function(visits, adg, qc = adg$settings, verbose = 1, cores = 1) {
  local_verbose(verbose)
  local_cores(cores)
  if (!inherits(adg, "ppt_adg")) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg adg} must be the result of {.fn calc_adg}.")
  }
  check_qc(qc)
  flagged <- if ("n_errors" %in% names(visits)) {
    as_dt(visits, "visits")
  } else {
    flag_feed_errors(visits, qc, bw = adg$daily[, .(responder, date, bw = predicted)],
                     verbose = ppt_verbose())
  }

  ppt_msg("ADFI over {qc$stage_range[1]}-{qc$stage_range[2]} kg", "h1")

  has_breed <- "breed" %in% names(adg$per_pig)
  pigs <- adg$per_pig[!is.na(adg), intersect(c("responder", "location", "breed", "adg", "adg_type", "stage"),
                                             names(adg$per_pig)), with = FALSE]
  data.table::setnames(pigs, "location", "pig_location")
  cov <- daily_error_covariates(flagged)[responder %in% pigs$responder]
  bw <- adg$daily[, .(responder, date, seq_days, bw = predicted, in_stage)]
  cov <- merge(cov, bw, by = c("responder", "date"), all.x = TRUE)
  cov <- merge(cov, pigs[, intersect(c("responder", "adg", "breed"), names(pigs)), with = FALSE],
               by = "responder")
  cov[, all_error := n_error_visits == n_visits]

  # 5c. correction
  corr <- correct_dfi(cov, qc)
  cov <- corr$data

  # range / quantile checks
  cov[, dfi_check := dfi_corrected]
  lim <- qc$dfi_range * 1000
  cov[!is.na(dfi_check) & (dfi_check < max(0, lim[1L]) | dfi_check > lim[2L]),
      `:=`(dfi_check = NA_real_, check_flag = "dfi_range")]
  if (!is.null(qc$dfi_quantile)) {
    q <- stats::quantile(cov$dfi_check, qc$dfi_quantile, na.rm = TRUE)
    cov[!is.na(dfi_check) & (dfi_check < q[1L] | dfi_check > q[2L]),
        `:=`(dfi_check = NA_real_, check_flag = "dfi_quantile")]
  }
  n_range <- cov[check_flag %in% "dfi_range", .N]
  n_quant <- cov[check_flag %in% "dfi_quantile", .N]

  # 5d. stage grid and imputation
  grid <- adg$daily[responder %in% pigs$responder,
                    .(responder, date, seq_days, bw = predicted, in_stage)]
  keep_cols <- c("responder", "date", "location", "n_visits", "n_error_visits",
                 "dfi_raw", "y", "dfi_corrected", "dfi_check", "all_error")
  daily <- merge(grid, cov[, keep_cols, with = FALSE],
                 by = c("responder", "date"), all = TRUE)
  daily <- merge(daily, pigs[, .(responder, pig_location)], by = "responder")
  daily[is.na(location), location := pig_location]
  daily[, in_stage := in_stage %in% TRUE]
  day0 <- adg$daily[, min(date - seq_days + 1L)]
  daily[is.na(seq_days), seq_days := as.integer(date - day0) + 1L]
  daily[, state := data.table::fcase(
    !is.na(dfi_check) & n_error_visits == 0L, "org",
    !is.na(dfi_check), "corr",
    default = NA_character_
  )]
  data.table::setorder(daily, responder, date)

  imp <- fit_by_pig(daily, impute_dfi_one_pig, step = "calc_adfi", qc = qc)
  daily <- imp$result
  data.table::setnames(daily, "y", "dfi_error_free")
  daily[, c("dfi_check", "pig_location", "all_error") := NULL]
  data.table::setcolorder(daily, c("responder", "location", "date", "seq_days",
                                   "bw", "in_stage", "n_visits", "n_error_visits",
                                   "dfi_raw", "dfi_error_free", "dfi_corrected",
                                   "dfi", "state"))

  st <- daily[in_stage == TRUE]
  per_pig <- st[, .(
    adfi = mean(dfi, na.rm = TRUE),
    adfi_raw = mean(dfi_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
    adfi_error_free = mean(dfi_error_free, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_stage_days = .N,
    n_observed = sum(state %in% c("org", "corr")),
    n_corrected = sum(state %in% "corr"),
    n_interpolated = sum(state %in% "iii"),
    n_extrapolated = sum(state %in% "elrp"),
    n_missing = sum(state %in% "missing"),
    n_extrap_start = edge_run(state[order(date)]),
    n_extrap_end = edge_run(rev(state[order(date)]))
  ), by = responder]
  per_pig[, coverage := n_observed / n_stage_days]
  per_pig[is.nan(adfi), adfi := NA_real_]
  per_pig <- merge(pigs[, intersect(c("responder", "pig_location", "breed", "stage", "adg_type"), names(pigs)),
                        with = FALSE],
                   per_pig, by = "responder", all.x = TRUE)
  data.table::setnames(per_pig, "pig_location", "location")
  data.table::setcolorder(per_pig, intersect(c("responder", "location", "breed", "stage", "adfi"), names(per_pig)))
  data.table::setorder(per_pig, location, responder)

  no_adfi <- per_pig[is.na(adfi)]
  why <- imp$failed$reason[match(no_adfi$responder, imp$failed$responder)]
  why <- data.table::fifelse(is.na(why), "no feed intake over the stage",
                             paste("imputation failed:", why))
  removed <- rbind(adg$removed,
                   new_removed(no_adfi$responder, no_adfi$location, "calc_adfi", why))

  report_adfi(per_pig, daily, corr, n_range, n_quant, qc)
  new_ppt_result(per_pig = per_pig, daily = daily, removed = removed,
                 settings = qc, class = "ppt_adfi") |>
    add_element(model = corr$coefficients)
}

# Fit the correction model and compute dfi_corrected.
correct_dfi <- function(cov, qc) {
  err_cols <- grep("^(pte|otd|fid)_", names(cov), value = TRUE)
  cov[, dfi_corrected := NA_real_]
  empty_coef <- data.table::data.table(term = character(), estimate = numeric(),
                                       std_error = numeric(), p_value = numeric())
  if (qc$dfi_correct == "none") {
    cov[, dfi_corrected := dfi_raw]
    return(list(data = cov, coefficients = empty_coef, status = "none", n_terms = 0L))
  }

  md <- cov[all_error == FALSE & !is.na(bw)]
  # keep error covariates that vary; drop those collinear with others
  varies <- vapply(err_cols, function(cl) stats::var(md[[cl]]) > 0, logical(1))
  terms <- err_cols[varies %in% TRUE]
  multi_loc <- data.table::uniqueN(md$location) > 1L
  multi_breed <- "breed" %in% names(md) && data.table::uniqueN(stats::na.omit(md$breed)) > 1L
  if (multi_breed) md[is.na(breed), breed := "unknown"]
  base <- c(if (multi_loc) "location", if (multi_breed) "breed", "bw", "adg")
  if (length(terms) > 0L) {
    lfit <- stats::lm(stats::reformulate(c(base, terms), "y"), data = md)
    aliased <- names(stats::coef(lfit))[is.na(stats::coef(lfit))]
    terms <- setdiff(terms, aliased)
  }
  if (length(terms) == 0L) {
    ppt_msg("No feeder errors to correct for: recorded intake used", "info")
    cov[all_error == FALSE, dfi_corrected := y]
    return(list(data = cov, coefficients = empty_coef, status = "no errors", n_terms = 0L))
  }

  if (multi_loc) md[, location := factor(location)]
  if (multi_breed) md[, breed := factor(breed)]
  fit <- tryCatch({
    X <- stats::model.matrix(stats::reformulate(c(base, terms)), data = md)
    lmm_ri_reml(md$y, X, md$responder)
  }, error = function(e) e)
  if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
    ppt_warn("The correction model failed ({conditionMessage(fit)}); error-free intake is not corrected.")
    cov[all_error == FALSE, dfi_corrected := y]
    return(list(data = cov, coefficients = empty_coef, status = "failed", n_terms = 0L))
  }

  coefs <- fit$coefficients
  b <- stats::setNames(coefs$estimate, coefs$term)[terms]
  x <- as.matrix(cov[, terms, with = FALSE])
  cov[, dfi_corrected := y - as.numeric(x %*% b)]
  cov[all_error == TRUE, dfi_corrected := NA_real_]
  list(data = cov, coefficients = coefs, status = "fitted",
       n_terms = length(terms), n_obs = nrow(md))
}

# Linear mixed model with a random intercept per pig, fitted by REML:
#   y = X b + u_pig + e,  u ~ N(0, s2_u),  e ~ N(0, s2_e).
# Same model as nlme::lme(y ~ X, random = ~ 1 | pig, method = "REML"), but
# much faster on large data: with lambda = s2_u / s2_e, each pig's rows are
# quasi-demeaned (y - theta * mean(y)), which turns the model into ordinary
# least squares; the REML likelihood is then profiled over lambda alone and
# maximised with optimize().
# Degrees of freedom for the t tests follow nlme: terms that are constant
# within every pig are tested on the between-pig df, the others on the
# within-pig df.
lmm_ri_reml <- function(y, X, group) {
  g <- as.integer(factor(group))
  n_g <- tabulate(g)
  N <- length(y)
  p <- ncol(X)
  # Everything needed is in cross-products, so each likelihood evaluation
  # costs O(pigs * p^2) instead of a QR of the full N x p matrix:
  #   Xs'Xs = X'X - sum_i c_i n_i xbar_i xbar_i',  c_i = 2 theta_i - theta_i^2
  # Columns are scaled first to keep the cross-products well conditioned.
  sc <- sqrt(colSums(X^2) / N)
  sc[sc == 0] <- 1
  Xn <- sweep(X, 2L, sc, "/")
  XtX <- crossprod(Xn)
  Xty <- crossprod(Xn, y)[, 1L]
  yty <- sum(y^2)
  Xbar <- rowsum(Xn, g, reorder = TRUE) / n_g
  ybar <- rowsum(y, g, reorder = TRUE)[, 1L] / n_g

  fit_at <- function(log_lambda) {
    theta <- 1 - 1 / sqrt(1 + exp(log_lambda) * n_g)
    cw <- (2 * theta - theta^2) * n_g
    A <- XtX - crossprod(Xbar * sqrt(cw))
    bvec <- Xty - colSums(Xbar * (cw * ybar))
    yy <- yty - sum(cw * ybar^2)
    R <- tryCatch(chol(A), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(R)) stop("the fixed-effect design is rank deficient")
    z <- backsolve(R, bvec, transpose = TRUE)
    rss <- yy - sum(z^2)
    logdet <- 2 * sum(log(diag(R))) + 2 * sum(log(sc))
    ll <- -0.5 * (sum(log(1 + exp(log_lambda) * n_g)) + logdet +
                    (N - p) * log(rss))
    list(ll = ll, R = R, z = z, rss = rss)
  }
  opt <- stats::optimize(function(l) fit_at(l)$ll, c(-12, 8), maximum = TRUE)
  log_lambda <- opt$maximum
  f <- fit_at(log_lambda)
  # variance on the boundary (lambda -> 0): plain least squares
  f0 <- fit_at(-30)
  if (f0$ll > f$ll) {
    f <- f0
    log_lambda <- -Inf
  }

  beta <- backsolve(f$R, f$z) / sc
  s2_e <- f$rss / (N - p)
  R_inv <- backsolve(f$R, diag(p))
  se <- sqrt(s2_e * rowSums(R_inv^2)) / sc

  # nlme-style denominator df
  # a term is between-pig when it is constant within every pig
  within_ss <- colSums(Xn^2) - colSums(Xbar^2 * n_g)
  between <- within_ss < 1e-8 * N
  n_groups <- length(n_g)
  df <- ifelse(between, n_groups - sum(between),
               N - n_groups - sum(!between))
  # like nlme, the intercept is tested on the within-pig df
  df[colnames(X) == "(Intercept)"] <- N - n_groups - sum(!between)
  df[df < 1] <- 1
  tval <- beta / se
  coefs <- data.table::data.table(
    term = colnames(X), estimate = unname(beta), std_error = unname(se),
    p_value = unname(2 * stats::pt(-abs(tval), df))
  )
  list(coefficients = coefs, sigma2_e = s2_e,
       sigma2_u = s2_e * exp(log_lambda), n_obs = N, n_groups = n_groups)
}

# Impute the stage days of one pig.
impute_dfi_one_pig <- function(d, qc) {
  d <- data.table::copy(d)
  ok <- !is.na(d$dfi_check)
  d[, dfi := dfi_check]
  need <- d$in_stage & !ok
  if (!any(need)) {
    d[in_stage == TRUE & is.na(state), state := "missing"]
    return(d)
  }
  x <- d$seq_days
  if (sum(ok) < 5L) {
    d[need, state := "missing"]
    return(d)
  }
  inside <- need & (x > min(x[ok]) & x < max(x[ok])) %in% TRUE
  outside <- need & !inside

  if (qc$impute_method == "linear") {
    if (any(inside)) {
      val <- stats::approx(x[ok], d$dfi_check[ok], xout = x[inside])$y
      # long gaps: robust LOESS instead of a straight line
      long <- run_length(inside)[inside] > qc$long_gap_days
      if (any(long) && sum(ok) >= 10L) {
        pred <- loess_extend(x[ok], d$dfi_check[ok], qc$loess_span)
        val[long] <- pmax(0, pred(x[inside][long]))
      }
      d[inside, `:=`(dfi = val, state = "iii")]
    }
    if (any(outside)) {
      okb <- ok & !is.na(d$bw)
      if (sum(okb) >= 5L && all(!is.na(d$bw[outside]))) {
        f <- stats::lm(dfi_check ~ bw, data = d[okb])
        d[outside, `:=`(dfi = pmax(0, stats::predict(f, newdata = d[outside])),
                        state = "elrp")]
      } else {
        d[outside, state := "missing"]
      }
    }
  } else {
    pred <- loess_extend(x[ok], d$dfi_check[ok], qc$loess_span)
    d[inside, `:=`(dfi = pmax(0, pred(x[inside])), state = "iii")]
    d[outside, `:=`(dfi = pmax(0, pred(x[outside])), state = "elrp")]
  }
  d[in_stage == TRUE & is.na(state), state := "missing"]
  d
}

# Length of the run of TRUE values each element belongs to (0 for FALSE).
run_length <- function(flag) {
  r <- rle(flag)
  len <- rep(r$lengths, r$lengths)
  len[!flag] <- 0L
  len
}

# Number of leading "elrp" states.
edge_run <- function(state) {
  r <- rle(state %in% "elrp")
  if (length(r$values) > 0L && r$values[1L]) r$lengths[1L] else 0L
}

# Robust LOESS prediction, continued linearly beyond the data range.
loess_extend <- function(x, y, span) {
  f <- stats::loess(y ~ x, span = span, degree = 1, family = "symmetric")
  core <- function(z) unname(stats::predict(f, newdata = data.frame(x = z)))
  rng <- range(x)
  h <- min(7, diff(rng) / 2)
  s_lo <- (core(rng[1] + h) - core(rng[1])) / h
  s_hi <- (core(rng[2]) - core(rng[2] - h)) / h
  function(z) {
    p <- core(pmin(pmax(z, rng[1]), rng[2]))
    p + pmin(z - rng[1], 0) * s_lo + pmax(z - rng[2], 0) * s_hi
  }
}

report_adfi <- function(per_pig, daily, corr, n_range, n_quant, qc) {
  if (corr$status == "fitted") {
    ppt_msg("Correction model: {corr$n_obs} pig-days, {corr$n_terms} error covariate{?s}", "info")
  }
  st <- daily[in_stage == TRUE, .N, by = state]
  get_n <- function(s) st[state == s, sum(N)]
  ppt_bullets_counts(c(
    "Stage days recorded without error (org)" = get_n("org"),
    "Corrected (corr)" = get_n("corr"),
    "Interpolated (iii)" = get_n("iii"),
    "Extrapolated (elrp)" = get_n("elrp"),
    "Missing" = get_n("missing"),
    "Pig-days outside dfi_range" = n_range,
    "Pig-days outside dfi_quantile" = if (is.null(qc$dfi_quantile)) NA else n_quant
  ))
  ok <- per_pig[!is.na(adfi)]
  if (nrow(ok) > 0L) {
    ppt_msg("Mean ADFI over the stage: {round(mean(ok$adfi))} g/d", "success")
    ppt_msg("Recorded stage days only: recorded {round(mean(ok$adfi_raw, na.rm = TRUE))} g/d, error-free part {round(mean(ok$adfi_error_free, na.rm = TRUE))} g/d", "info", level = 2L)
  }
  if (any(is.na(per_pig$adfi))) {
    ppt_msg("No ADFI for {sum(is.na(per_pig$adfi))} pig{?s}", "warning")
  }
  low <- ok[coverage < 0.7]
  if (nrow(low) > 0L) {
    ppt_msg("{nrow(low)} pig{?s} with less than 70% of the stage recorded", "warning")
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r tests-calc_adfi}
run_adfi <- function(data, qc = qc_config(), ...) {
  v <- prep_visits(data, verbose = 0)
  a <- suppressWarnings(calc_adg(clean_weight(v, qc, verbose = 0), verbose = 0))
  list(visits = v, adg = a, adfi = calc_adfi(v, a, verbose = 0, ...))
}

test_that("calc_adfi runs on both datasets", {
  for (data in list(nedap, fire)) {
    r <- run_adfi(data)
    f <- r$adfi
    expect_s3_class(f, c("ppt_adfi", "ppt_result"))
    expect_equal(nrow(f$per_pig), r$adg$per_pig[!is.na(adg), .N])
    expect_false(anyNA(f$per_pig$adfi))
    ok <- f$per_pig[!is.na(adfi)]
    expect_true(all(ok$adfi > 800 & ok$adfi < 4500))
    expect_true(all(ok$coverage >= 0 & ok$coverage <= 1))
    expect_true(all(f$daily$state %in% c("org", "corr", "iii", "elrp", "missing", NA)))
    expect_true(all(c("term", "estimate", "std_error", "p_value") %in% names(f$model)))
  }
})

test_that("days without errors keep their recorded intake", {
  f <- run_adfi(fire)$adfi
  org <- f$daily[state == "org"]
  expect_gt(nrow(org), 0)
  expect_equal(org$dfi, org$dfi_raw)
  expect_equal(org$dfi_corrected, org$dfi_error_free)
})

test_that("correction adds back feed lost in error visits", {
  f <- run_adfi(fire)$adfi
  corr <- f$daily[state == "corr"]
  expect_gt(nrow(corr), 0)
  # on corrected days the estimate is above the error-free part
  expect_gt(mean(corr$dfi_corrected), mean(corr$dfi_error_free))
  # error-share coefficients are negative, as in Jiao et al. (2014) Table 1
  pte <- f$model[grepl("^pte_", term) & p_value < 0.05, estimate]
  expect_gt(mean(pte < 0), 0.5)
})

test_that("visits do not need to be flagged beforehand", {
  r <- run_adfi(fire)
  flagged <- flag_feed_errors(r$visits, verbose = 0)
  f2 <- calc_adfi(flagged, r$adg, verbose = 0)
  expect_equal(f2$per_pig$adfi, r$adfi$per_pig$adfi)
})

test_that("the fast REML fit matches nlme::lme", {
  skip_if_not_installed("nlme")
  set.seed(1)
  d <- data.frame(pig = rep(sprintf("p%02d", 1:40), times = sample(15:40, 40, TRUE)))
  n <- nrow(d)
  pig_x <- stats::rnorm(40)
  d$b <- pig_x[as.integer(factor(d$pig))]           # constant within pig
  d$x1 <- stats::rnorm(n)
  d$x2 <- stats::rbinom(n, 1, 0.3)
  d$y <- 2 + 0.5 * d$b + 1.5 * d$x1 - d$x2 +
    stats::rnorm(40, sd = 0.8)[as.integer(factor(d$pig))] + stats::rnorm(n)
  ours <- lmm_ri_reml(d$y, stats::model.matrix(~ b + x1 + x2, d), d$pig)
  ref <- nlme::lme(y ~ b + x1 + x2, random = ~ 1 | pig, data = d, method = "REML")
  tt <- summary(ref)$tTable
  expect_equal(ours$coefficients$estimate, unname(tt[, "Value"]), tolerance = 1e-4)
  expect_equal(ours$coefficients$std_error, unname(tt[, "Std.Error"]), tolerance = 1e-3)
  expect_equal(ours$coefficients$p_value, unname(tt[, "p-value"]), tolerance = 1e-3)
  expect_equal(ours$sigma2_e, ref$sigma^2, tolerance = 1e-3)
})

test_that("no correction uses the recorded intake", {
  r <- run_adfi(fire)
  f <- calc_adfi(r$visits, r$adg, qc = qc_config(dfi_correct = "none"), verbose = 0)
  obs <- f$daily[state %in% c("org", "corr")]
  expect_equal(obs$dfi, obs$dfi_raw)
  expect_equal(nrow(f$model), 0L)
})

test_that("missing days are interpolated inside and extrapolated outside", {
  v <- prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0)
  pig <- v[identified == TRUE, responder][1]
  days <- sort(unique(v[responder == pig, date]))
  gap <- days[40:44]
  v2 <- v[!(responder %in% pig & date %in% gap)]
  a <- calc_adg(clean_weight(v2, verbose = 0), verbose = 0)
  f <- calc_adfi(v2, a, verbose = 0)
  d <- f$daily[responder == pig & date %in% gap]
  expect_equal(d$state, rep("iii", 5))
  around <- f$daily[responder == pig & date %in% days[c(39, 45)], dfi]
  expect_true(all(d$dfi >= min(around) - 1 & d$dfi <= max(around) + 1))
  # FIRE pigs enter above 30 kg: the stage start is extrapolated
  ff <- run_adfi(fire)$adfi
  expect_gt(ff$daily[state == "elrp", .N], 0)
})

test_that("long gaps use LOESS, short gaps a straight line", {
  v <- prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0)
  pig <- v[identified == TRUE, responder][1]
  days <- sort(unique(v[responder == pig, date]))
  gap <- days[30:41]                                   # 12-day gap
  v2 <- v[!(responder %in% pig & date %in% gap)]
  a <- calc_adg(clean_weight(v2, verbose = 0), verbose = 0)
  lin <- calc_adfi(v2, a, qc = qc_config(long_gap_days = 100), verbose = 0)
  lo <- calc_adfi(v2, a, qc = qc_config(long_gap_days = 7), verbose = 0)
  dl <- lin$daily[responder == pig & date %in% gap]
  dz <- lo$daily[responder == pig & date %in% gap]
  expect_equal(dl$state, rep("iii", 12))
  expect_equal(dz$state, rep("iii", 12))
  # a straight line has constant steps, LOESS does not
  expect_lt(stats::sd(diff(dl$dfi)), 1e-6)
  expect_gt(stats::sd(diff(dz$dfi)), 1e-6)
  expect_equal(run_length(c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE)), c(2L, 2L, 0L, 1L))
})

test_that("loess imputation and edge counts work", {
  r <- run_adfi(fire)
  f <- calc_adfi(r$visits, r$adg, qc = qc_config(impute_method = "loess"), verbose = 0)
  expect_gt(f$daily[state %in% c("iii", "elrp"), .N], 0)
  expect_false(anyNA(f$per_pig$adfi))
  p <- r$adfi$per_pig
  expect_true(all(p$n_extrap_start + p$n_extrap_end <= p$n_extrapolated))
  expect_gt(max(p$n_extrap_start), 15)                 # FIRE pigs enter late
  expect_equal(edge_run(c("elrp", "elrp", "org", "elrp")), 2L)
})

test_that("dfi range and quantile limits set values to missing", {
  r <- run_adfi(fire)
  f <- calc_adfi(r$visits, r$adg, qc = qc_config(dfi_range = c(1, 3)), verbose = 0)
  obs <- f$daily[state %in% c("org", "corr")]
  expect_true(all(obs$dfi >= 1000 & obs$dfi <= 3000))
  fq <- calc_adfi(r$visits, r$adg, qc = qc_config(dfi_quantile = c(0.1, 0.9)), verbose = 0)
  expect_lt(fq$daily[state %in% c("org", "corr"), .N], f$daily[state %in% c("org", "corr"), .N] + 1e6)
})

test_that("inputs are not modified and bad inputs are rejected", {
  r <- run_adfi(fire)
  before <- data.table::copy(r$visits)
  calc_adfi(r$visits, r$adg, verbose = 0)
  expect_equal(as.list(r$visits), as.list(before))
  expect_error(calc_adfi(r$visits, list()), "calc_adg")
})
```

# calc_fcr

`calc_fcr()` combines ADG and ADFI, both computed over the same body weight
stage, into the feed conversion ratio FCR = ADFI / ADG (kg feed per kg
gain) and its inverse, feed efficiency G:F = ADG / ADFI.

Each pig gets `fcr_flag = "ok"` or `"low_confidence"`, with the reasons in
`fcr_note`: the growth curve or the feed intake extrapolated over more
than `max_edge_extrap_days` (default 15) at the start or end of the stage,
an inner 10 kg class with recorded weights spanning less than
`min_bin_coverage_kg` (default 6 kg), a segment FCR outside the optional
`bin_fcr_limits`,
ADG on part of the stage only, less than `min_coverage` (default 0.7) of
the stage with recorded feed intake, or weight data flagged by
[clean_weight()].

```{r function-calc_fcr}
#' Compute Feed Conversion Ratio (FCR) with Confidence Flags
#'
#' @description
#' Compute feed conversion ratio (FCR) from ADG and ADFI over the same body
#' weight stage, flag pigs whose values rely on extrapolation, and summarise
#' the traits.
#'
#' @param adg Result of [calc_adg()].
#' @param adfi Result of [calc_adfi()] computed from the same `adg`.
#' @param min_coverage Minimum share of stage days with recorded feed
#'   intake for `fcr_flag = "ok"`. Default: `min_coverage` of the QC
#'   settings (0.7).
#' @param verbose 0 (silent), 1 (summary, default) or 2 (details).
#'
#' @return An object of class `ppt_fcr` (a list):
#'   - `per_pig`: `adg` (g/d), `adfi` (g/d), `fcr`, `gf`, `adg_type`,
#'     `coverage`, `stage_days`, `start_weight`, `end_weight`, `fcr_flag`,
#'     `fcr_note`;
#'   - `daily`: the daily table of [calc_adfi()];
#'   - `summary`: numeric summary (`n`, `min`, `max`, `median`, `mean`,
#'     `sd`, `cv`) of the main traits, for all pigs, for pigs with
#'     `fcr_flag = "ok"` and, with a `breed` column, for each breed;
#'   - `by_bin`: one row per pig and body weight class of `bin_width` kg:
#'     feed (`feed_kg`), gain (`gain_kg`), segment `fcr`,
#'     `weight_coverage_kg` (span of recorded body weights in the class),
#'     `low_coverage` (inner class covered by less than
#'     `min_bin_coverage_kg`) and `fcr_out` (segment FCR outside
#'     `bin_fcr_limits`);
#'   - `removed`, `settings`.
#'
#' @seealso [calc_adg()], [calc_adfi()].
#' @export
calc_fcr <- function(adg, adfi, min_coverage = adg$settings$min_coverage,
                     verbose = 1) {
  local_verbose(verbose)
  if (!inherits(adg, "ppt_adg")) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg adg} must be the result of {.fn calc_adg}.")
  }
  if (!inherits(adfi, "ppt_adfi")) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg adfi} must be the result of {.fn calc_adfi}.")
  }
  if (!identical(adg$settings$stage_range, adfi$settings$stage_range)) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg adg} and {.arg adfi} use different {.field stage_range}.")
  }
  ppt_msg("FCR over {adg$settings$stage_range[1]}-{adg$settings$stage_range[2]} kg", "h1")

  a <- adg$per_pig[, intersect(c("responder", "location", "breed", "stage", "adg", "adg_type",
                                "stage_days", "start_weight", "end_weight", "weight_status",
                                "extrap_days_start", "extrap_days_end"), names(adg$per_pig)),
                   with = FALSE]
  f <- adfi$per_pig[, .(responder, adfi, coverage, n_extrap_start, n_extrap_end)]
  max_edge <- adg$settings$max_edge_extrap_days
  per_pig <- merge(a, f, by = "responder", all.x = TRUE)
  per_pig[, `:=`(fcr = adfi / adg, gf = adg / adfi)]

  notes <- character(nrow(per_pig))
  add_note <- function(cond, text) {
    cond <- cond %in% TRUE
    if (!any(cond)) return(invisible(NULL))
    text <- if (length(text) == 1L) rep(text, sum(cond)) else text[cond]
    notes[cond] <<- ifelse(nzchar(notes[cond]), paste(notes[cond], text, sep = "; "), text)
  }
  add_note(per_pig$adg_type == "partial", "ADG on part of the stage")
  add_note(per_pig$extrap_days_start > max_edge,
           sprintf("growth curve extrapolated %.0f d before the first weight", per_pig$extrap_days_start))
  add_note(per_pig$extrap_days_end > max_edge,
           sprintf("growth curve extrapolated %.0f d after the last weight", per_pig$extrap_days_end))
  add_note(per_pig$n_extrap_start > max_edge,
           sprintf("feed intake extrapolated for the first %d stage days", as.integer(per_pig$n_extrap_start)))
  add_note(per_pig$n_extrap_end > max_edge,
           sprintf("feed intake extrapolated for the last %d stage days", as.integer(per_pig$n_extrap_end)))
  add_note(per_pig$coverage < min_coverage,
           sprintf("feed intake recorded on %.0f%% of the stage", 100 * per_pig$coverage))
  add_note(per_pig$weight_status == "low_confidence", "weight data flagged")
  by_bin <- fcr_by_bin(adg, adfi, adg$settings)
  bin_notes <- by_bin[low_coverage == TRUE | fcr_out == TRUE, .(note = paste(
    c(if (any(low_coverage)) sprintf("weight records cover %.1f kg of %s-%s kg",
                                     weight_coverage_kg[low_coverage], weight_from[low_coverage], weight_to[low_coverage]),
      if (any(fcr_out)) sprintf("segment FCR %.2f outside %s-%s in %s-%s kg", fcr[fcr_out],
                                fcr_min[fcr_out], fcr_max[fcr_out], weight_from[fcr_out], weight_to[fcr_out])),
    collapse = "; ")), by = responder]
  m <- match(per_pig$responder, bin_notes$responder)
  add_note(!is.na(m), bin_notes$note[m])
  add_note(is.na(per_pig$fcr), "no FCR")
  per_pig[, `:=`(fcr_note = notes,
                 fcr_flag = data.table::fifelse(nzchar(notes), "low_confidence", "ok"))]
  per_pig[is.na(fcr), fcr_flag := NA_character_]
  per_pig[, weight_status := NULL]
  data.table::setcolorder(per_pig, intersect(c("responder", "location", "breed", "stage", "adg", "adfi",
                                     "fcr", "gf", "adg_type", "coverage", "stage_days",
                                     "start_weight", "end_weight", "fcr_flag", "fcr_note"), names(per_pig)))
  data.table::setorder(per_pig, location, responder)

  summary <- rbind(
    trait_summary(per_pig, "all"),
    trait_summary(per_pig[fcr_flag %in% "ok"], "ok")
  )
  if ("breed" %in% names(per_pig)) {
    for (b in sort(unique(stats::na.omit(per_pig$breed)))) {
      summary <- rbind(summary, trait_summary(per_pig[breed %in% b], paste("breed", b)))
    }
  }

  n_ok <- per_pig[fcr_flag %in% "ok", .N]
  n_low <- per_pig[fcr_flag %in% "low_confidence", .N]
  ppt_msg("FCR for {sum(!is.na(per_pig$fcr))} pig{?s}: {n_ok} ok, {n_low} low confidence", "info")
  s <- summary[group == "all" & trait == "fcr"]
  if (nrow(s) == 1L && s$n > 0) {
    ppt_msg("Mean FCR {sprintf('%.2f', s$mean)} (SD {sprintf('%.2f', s$sd)}), ADG {round(summary[group == 'all' & trait == 'adg', mean])} g/d, ADFI {round(summary[group == 'all' & trait == 'adfi', mean])} g/d", "success")
  }
  if (n_low > 0L) {
    why <- sort(table(unlist(strsplit(per_pig[fcr_flag %in% "low_confidence", fcr_note], "; "))), decreasing = TRUE)
    why <- unique(gsub("[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?", "N", names(why)))
    ppt_msg("Low confidence because of: {paste(unique(why), collapse = ', ')}", "info", level = 2L)
  }

  new_ppt_result(per_pig = per_pig, daily = adfi$daily, removed = adfi$removed,
                 settings = adg$settings, class = "ppt_fcr") |>
    add_element(summary = summary, by_bin = by_bin)
}

# Feed intake, gain and FCR per body weight class of each pig.
fcr_by_bin <- function(adg, adfi, qc) {
  lo <- qc$stage_range[1L]
  hi <- qc$stage_range[2L]
  width <- qc$bin_width
  cls <- function(w) lo + floor((w - lo) / width) * width
  st <- adfi$daily[in_stage == TRUE & !is.na(bw) & !is.na(dfi)]
  st[, weight_from := cls(bw)]
  st <- st[weight_from >= lo & weight_from < hi]
  bins <- st[, .(n_days = .N, n_observed_feed = sum(state %in% c("org", "corr")),
                 feed_kg = sum(dfi) / 1000, bw_min = min(bw), bw_max = max(bw)),
             by = .(responder, weight_from)]
  # gain over the days of the class (daily weights are mid-day values)
  bins[, gain_kg := data.table::fifelse(n_days > 1L, (bw_max - bw_min) * n_days / (n_days - 1L), NA_real_)]
  bins[, fcr := feed_kg / gain_kg]
  bins[, weight_to := pmin(weight_from + width, hi)]

  # how much of each class is covered by recorded body weights
  ob <- adg$daily[source == "observed" & !is.na(weight)]
  ob[, weight_from := cls(weight)]
  cov <- ob[weight_from >= lo & weight_from < hi,
            .(weight_coverage_kg = max(weight) - min(weight)), by = .(responder, weight_from)]
  bins <- merge(bins, cov, by = c("responder", "weight_from"), all.x = TRUE)
  bins[is.na(weight_coverage_kg), weight_coverage_kg := 0]
  rng <- cov[, .(first_bin = min(weight_from), last_bin = max(weight_from)), by = responder]
  bins <- merge(bins, rng, by = "responder", all.x = TRUE)
  bins[, inner := (weight_from > first_bin & weight_from < last_bin) %in% TRUE]
  bins[, low_coverage := inner & weight_coverage_kg < qc$min_bin_coverage_kg]

  bins[, `:=`(fcr_min = NA_real_, fcr_max = NA_real_)]
  if (!is.null(qc$bin_fcr_limits)) {
    lim <- data.table::as.data.table(qc$bin_fcr_limits)
    bins[lim, on = "weight_from", `:=`(fcr_min = i.fcr_min, fcr_max = i.fcr_max)]
  }
  bins[, fcr_out := !is.na(fcr) & !is.na(fcr_min) & (fcr < fcr_min | fcr > fcr_max)]
  bins[, c("bw_min", "bw_max", "first_bin", "last_bin") := NULL]
  data.table::setcolorder(bins, c("responder", "weight_from", "weight_to", "n_days",
                                  "n_observed_feed", "feed_kg", "gain_kg", "fcr",
                                  "weight_coverage_kg", "inner", "low_coverage",
                                  "fcr_min", "fcr_max", "fcr_out"))
  data.table::setorder(bins, responder, weight_from)
  bins[]
}

trait_summary <- function(p, group) {
  traits <- c("adg", "adfi", "fcr", "gf", "stage_days", "start_weight", "end_weight")
  out <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(traits, function(tr) {
    x <- p[[tr]]
    x <- x[!is.na(x)]
    n <- length(x)
    data.table::data.table(
      group = group, trait = tr, n = n,
      min = if (n) min(x) else NA_real_,
      max = if (n) max(x) else NA_real_,
      median = if (n) stats::median(x) else NA_real_,
      mean = if (n) mean(x) else NA_real_,
      sd = if (n > 1L) stats::sd(x) else NA_real_
    )
  }))
  out[, cv := sd / mean]
  out[]
}
```

```{r example-calc_fcr}
visits <- prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0)
adg <- calc_adg(clean_weight(visits, verbose = 0), verbose = 0)
adfi <- calc_adfi(visits, adg, verbose = 0)
fcr <- calc_fcr(adg, adfi)
head(fcr$per_pig[, .(responder, adg, adfi, fcr, fcr_flag, fcr_note)])
fcr$summary[group == "all"]
```
