```{r tests-calc_fcr}
fcr_pipeline <- function(data) {
  v <- prep_visits(data, verbose = 0)
  a <- suppressWarnings(calc_adg(clean_weight(v, verbose = 0), verbose = 0))
  f <- calc_adfi(v, a, verbose = 0)
  list(adg = a, adfi = f, fcr = calc_fcr(a, f, verbose = 0))
}

test_that("FCR is ADFI / ADG and flags explain themselves", {
  for (data in list(nedap, fire)) {
    r <- fcr_pipeline(data)
    p <- r$fcr$per_pig
    expect_s3_class(r$fcr, c("ppt_fcr", "ppt_result"))
    expect_equal(nrow(p), nrow(r$adg$per_pig))
    expect_equal(p$fcr, p$adfi / p$adg)
    expect_equal(p$gf, 1 / p$fcr)
    ok <- p[!is.na(fcr)]
    expect_true(all(ok$fcr > 1.5 & ok$fcr < 4.5))
    expect_true(all(ok[fcr_flag == "ok", nchar(fcr_note)] == 0))
    expect_true(all(ok[fcr_flag == "low_confidence", nchar(fcr_note)] > 0))
    long <- p[extrap_days_start > 15 | extrap_days_end > 15 | n_extrap_start > 15 | n_extrap_end > 15]
    expect_true(all(long$fcr_flag == "low_confidence"))
    short <- p[!responder %in% long$responder]
    expect_false(any(grepl("extrapolated", short$fcr_note)))
  }
})

test_that("each note describes its own pig", {
  r <- fcr_pipeline(fire)
  p <- r$fcr$per_pig[grepl("feed intake recorded on", fcr_note)]
  expect_gt(nrow(p), 0)
  shown <- as.numeric(sub(".*feed intake recorded on ([0-9]+)%.*", "\\1", p$fcr_note))
  expect_equal(shown, round(100 * p$coverage))
  e <- r$fcr$per_pig[grepl("extrapolated .* d before", fcr_note)]
  shown_d <- as.numeric(sub(".*extrapolated ([0-9]+) d before.*", "\\1", e$fcr_note))
  expect_equal(shown_d, round(e$extrap_days_start))
})

test_that("summary is numeric and consistent", {
  r <- fcr_pipeline(nedap)
  s <- r$fcr$summary
  expect_true(all(vapply(s[, .(n, min, max, median, mean, sd, cv)], is.numeric, logical(1))))
  expect_equal(s[group == "all" & trait == "fcr", mean], mean(r$fcr$per_pig$fcr, na.rm = TRUE))
  expect_equal(s[group == "ok" & trait == "fcr", n], r$fcr$per_pig[fcr_flag %in% "ok", .N])
  expect_equal(s$cv, s$sd / s$mean)
})

test_that("breed enters the correction model and the summary", {
  v <- prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0)
  pigs <- unique(v[identified == TRUE, responder])
  v <- add_breed(v, data.frame(responder = pigs, breed = rep(c("YY", "LL"), length.out = length(pigs))), verbose = 0)
  a <- calc_adg(clean_weight(v, verbose = 0), verbose = 0)
  f <- calc_adfi(v, a, verbose = 0)
  expect_true(any(grepl("^breed", f$model$term)))
  expect_true("breed" %in% names(f$per_pig))
  r <- calc_fcr(a, f, verbose = 0)
  expect_true(all(c("breed LL", "breed YY") %in% r$summary$group))
  expect_true("breed" %in% names(r$per_pig))
})

test_that("weight classes: coverage and optional FCR limits", {
  r <- fcr_pipeline(nedap)
  b <- r$fcr$by_bin
  expect_true(all(c("weight_from", "weight_to", "feed_kg", "gain_kg", "fcr",
                    "weight_coverage_kg", "low_coverage", "fcr_out") %in% names(b)))
  expect_true(all(b$weight_from >= 30 & b$weight_to <= 120))
  expect_false(any(b$fcr_out))                         # no limits by default
  low <- b[low_coverage == TRUE, unique(responder)]
  expect_true(all(r$fcr$per_pig[responder %in% low, fcr_flag] == "low_confidence"))
  expect_true(all(grepl("weight records cover", r$fcr$per_pig[responder %in% low, fcr_note])))
  # very narrow limits flag every pig
  q <- qc_config(bin_fcr_limits = data.frame(weight_from = seq(30, 110, 10), fcr_min = 2.40, fcr_max = 2.41))
  v <- prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0)
  a <- calc_adg(clean_weight(v, q, verbose = 0), verbose = 0)
  f2 <- calc_fcr(a, calc_adfi(v, a, verbose = 0), verbose = 0)
  expect_true(any(f2$by_bin$fcr_out))
  expect_true(all(grepl("segment FCR", f2$per_pig[responder %in% f2$by_bin[fcr_out == TRUE, responder], fcr_note])))
})

test_that("max_edge_extrap_days changes the flags", {
  v <- prep_visits(fire, verbose = 0)
  q <- qc_config(max_edge_extrap_days = 1000, min_coverage = 0)
  a <- suppressWarnings(calc_adg(clean_weight(v, q, verbose = 0), verbose = 0))
  p <- calc_fcr(a, calc_adfi(v, a, verbose = 0), verbose = 0)$per_pig
  expect_false(any(grepl("extrapolated", p$fcr_note)))
})

test_that("min_coverage changes the flags", {
  r <- fcr_pipeline(fire)
  strict <- calc_fcr(r$adg, r$adfi, min_coverage = 1, verbose = 0)$per_pig
  expect_true(all(strict$fcr_flag == "low_confidence"))
})

test_that("inputs are checked and not modified", {
  r <- fcr_pipeline(nedap)
  before <- data.table::copy(r$adg$per_pig)
  calc_fcr(r$adg, r$adfi, verbose = 0)
  expect_equal(r$adg$per_pig, before)
  expect_error(calc_fcr(r$adfi, r$adfi), "calc_adg")
  expect_error(calc_fcr(r$adg, r$adg), "calc_adfi")
  other <- r$adfi
  other$settings <- qc_config(stage_range = c(40, 110))
  expect_error(calc_fcr(r$adg, other), "stage_range")
})
```

# plot_adg, plot_adfi and save_plots

One plot per station, one panel per pig. Axes adapt to the data and to
`stage_range`, so no point is dropped. Colours come from a colour-blind safe
palette (Okabe-Ito) without extra packages.

```{r function-plots}
#' Plot Growth Curves per Station
#'
#' @description
#' Plot body weight and the fitted growth curve of each pig, one plot per
#' station.
#'
#' @param adg Result of [calc_adg()].
#' @param weight Optional result of [clean_weight()] to also show every
#'   weight record, with outliers highlighted.
#' @param responders,locations Optional pig IDs and stations to plot.
#' @param ncol Number of panel columns. Default 3.
#' @param verbose 0 (silent), 1 (summary, default).
#'
#' @return A `data.table` with one row per station: `location`, `n_pigs`
#'   and `plot` (a list of ggplot objects). Use [save_plots()] to write them
#'   to files.
#' @export
plot_adg <- function(adg, weight = NULL, responders = NULL, locations = NULL,
                     ncol = 3, verbose = 1) {
  local_verbose(verbose)
  if (!inherits(adg, "ppt_adg")) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg adg} must be the result of {.fn calc_adg}.")
  }
  if (!is.null(weight) && !inherits(weight, "ppt_weight")) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg weight} must be the result of {.fn clean_weight}.")
  }
  daily <- filter_pigs(adg$daily, responders, locations)
  info <- adg$per_pig[responder %in% daily$responder]
  stage_rng <- adg$settings$stage_range
  rec <- if (!is.null(weight)) weight$records[responder %in% daily$responder] else NULL

  cols <- c(record = "#BBBBBB", outlier = "#D55E00", observed = "#0072B2",
            curve = "#009E73", stage = "#000000")
  info[, label := sprintf("ADG %s g/d (%s)\n%s-%s kg in %s d",
                          ifelse(is.na(adg), "NA", format(round(adg))), adg_type,
                          stage_rng[1L], stage_rng[2L],
                          ifelse(is.na(stage_days), "NA", sprintf("%.1f", stage_days)))]

  # Each plot is built by a top-level helper that only receives its own
  # station's data. A ggplot keeps the environment it was created in, so
  # building it inside this function would drag every pig's records along
  # (hundreds of MB per plot), which makes saving and parallel export slow.
  plots <- lapply(split(daily, by = "location", sorted = TRUE), function(d) {
    lv <- natural_order(unique(d$responder))
    lab <- info[location == d$location[1L] | responder %in% lv]
    r <- if (!is.null(rec)) rec[responder %in% lv] else NULL
    adg_station_plot(d, r, lab, lv, stage_rng, cols, ncol)
  })
  out <- data.table::data.table(location = names(plots),
                                n_pigs = vapply(plots, function(p) data.table::uniqueN(p$data$responder), integer(1)),
                                plot = unname(plots))
  ppt_msg("Created {nrow(out)} growth plot{?s}", "success")
  out
}

#' Plot Daily Feed Intake per Station
#'
#' @description
#' Plot recorded and corrected daily feed intake of each pig over the stage,
#' one plot per station. Point colours show how each day was obtained.
#'
#' @param adfi Result of [calc_adfi()].
#' @inheritParams plot_adg
#'
#' @return A `data.table` with `location`, `n_pigs` and `plot`.
#' @export
plot_adfi <- function(adfi, responders = NULL, locations = NULL, ncol = 3,
                      verbose = 1) {
  local_verbose(verbose)
  if (!inherits(adfi, "ppt_adfi")) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg adfi} must be the result of {.fn calc_adfi}.")
  }
  daily <- filter_pigs(adfi$daily[in_stage == TRUE], responders, locations)
  info <- adfi$per_pig[responder %in% daily$responder]
  info[, label := sprintf("ADFI %s g/d\nrecorded on %s of the stage",
                          ifelse(is.na(adfi), "NA", format(round(adfi))),
                          ifelse(is.na(coverage), "NA", sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * coverage)))]
  cols <- c(raw = "#BBBBBB", org = "#0072B2", corr = "#E69F00",
            iii = "#009E73", elrp = "#CC79A7", missing = "#D55E00")
  labels <- c(raw = "recorded", org = "error-free", corr = "corrected",
              iii = "interpolated", elrp = "extrapolated", missing = "missing")

  plots <- lapply(split(daily, by = "location", sorted = TRUE), function(d) {
    lv <- natural_order(unique(d$responder))
    adfi_station_plot(d, info[responder %in% lv], lv, cols, labels, ncol)
  })
  out <- data.table::data.table(location = names(plots),
                                n_pigs = vapply(plots, function(p) data.table::uniqueN(p$data$responder), integer(1)),
                                plot = unname(plots))
  ppt_msg("Created {nrow(out)} feed intake plot{?s}", "success")
  out
}

#' Save Plots to Files
#'
#' @param plots Result of [plot_adg()] or [plot_adfi()].
#' @param path Folder to write to (created if needed).
#' @param prefix,suffix File name parts: `<prefix>_<location>_<suffix>.<device>`.
#' @param device `"png"`, `"pdf"`, `"jpeg"` or `"tiff"`.
#' @param dpi Resolution for bitmap devices. Default 300.
#' @param width,height Size in cm. By default computed from the number of
#'   panels.
#' @param cores Number of CPU cores: stations are saved in parallel when
#'   > 1. Default 1. Saving is mostly ggplot2 drawing time (about 1 s per
#'   station of 15 pigs), so with many stations this is the main speed-up.
#' @param verbose 0 (silent), 1 (summary, default).
#'
#' @return Invisibly, a `data.table` with `location`, `file` and `saved`.
#' @export
save_plots <- function(plots, path, prefix = "station", suffix = "plot",
                       device = c("png", "pdf", "jpeg", "tiff"), dpi = 300,
                       width = NULL, height = NULL, verbose = 1, cores = 1) {
  local_verbose(verbose)
  device <- match.arg(device)
  cores <- check_cores(cores)
  if (!data.table::is.data.table(plots) || !all(c("location", "plot") %in% names(plots))) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg plots} must be the result of {.fn plot_adg} or {.fn plot_adfi}.")
  }
  dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  n <- nrow(plots)
  jobs <- lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
    p <- plots$plot[[i]]
    nc <- p$facet$params$ncol %||% 3L
    list(plot = p,
         file = file.path(path, paste0(prefix, "_", plots$location[i], "_", suffix, ".", device)),
         width = width %||% max(16, 9 * nc),
         height = height %||% (6 * ceiling(plots$n_pigs[i] / nc) + 4))
  })

  errs <- if (cores > 1L && n > 1L) {
    if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
      cl <- parallel::makeCluster(min(cores, n))
      on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cl), add = TRUE)
      parallel::parLapply(cl, jobs, save_one_plot, device = device, dpi = dpi)
    } else {
      parallel::mclapply(jobs, save_one_plot, device = device, dpi = dpi,
                         mc.cores = min(cores, n), mc.preschedule = FALSE)
    }
  } else if (ppt_verbose() >= 1L && n > 1L) {
    out <- vector("list", n)
    cli::cli_progress_bar("Saving plots", total = n, clear = TRUE,
                          .envir = environment())
    for (i in seq_len(n)) {
      out[[i]] <- save_one_plot(jobs[[i]], device = device, dpi = dpi)
      cli::cli_progress_update(.envir = environment())
    }
    cli::cli_progress_done(.envir = environment())
    out
  } else {
    lapply(jobs, save_one_plot, device = device, dpi = dpi)
  }

  files <- vapply(jobs, `[[`, "", "file")
  ok <- vapply(errs, function(e) is.character(e) && length(e) == 1L && is.na(e), logical(1))
  for (i in which(!ok)) {
    msg <- if (is.character(errs[[i]])) errs[[i]] else "worker failed"
    file <- files[i]
    ppt_warn("Could not save {.file {file}}: {msg}")
  }
  res <- data.table::data.table(location = plots$location, file = files, saved = ok)
  ppt_msg("Saved {sum(res$saved)} of {nrow(res)} plot{?s} to {.path {path}}",
          if (all(res$saved)) "success" else "warning")
  invisible(res)
}

# Save one plot; returns NA on success or the error message.
save_one_plot <- function(job, device, dpi) {
  tryCatch({
    ggplot2::ggsave(job$file, job$plot, width = job$width, height = job$height,
                    units = "cm", dpi = dpi, device = device, limitsize = FALSE)
    NA_character_
  }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
}

adg_station_plot <- function(d, rec, lab, lv, stage_rng, cols, ncol) {
  loc <- d$location[1L]
  d <- data.table::copy(d)[, responder := factor(responder, levels = lv)]
  lab <- data.table::copy(lab)[, responder := factor(responder, levels = lv)]
  lab <- lab[!is.na(responder)]
  y_rng <- range(c(d$lower, d$upper, d$weight, stage_rng, rec$weight), na.rm = TRUE)
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x = date)) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = stage_rng, linetype = "dashed",
                        colour = cols[["stage"]], alpha = 0.4) +
    ggplot2::geom_ribbon(ggplot2::aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                         fill = cols[["curve"]], alpha = 0.15)
  if (!is.null(rec)) {
    r <- data.table::copy(rec)[, responder := factor(responder, levels = lv)]
    r[, kind := data.table::fifelse(outlier, "outlier", "record")]
    r <- r[, .(date, responder, weight, kind)]
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_point(data = r, ggplot2::aes(y = weight, colour = kind),
                                 size = 0.4, alpha = 0.6)
  }
  brk <- c("observed", "curve", if (!is.null(rec)) c("record", "outlier"))
  p +
    ggplot2::geom_point(data = d[!is.na(weight)],
                        ggplot2::aes(y = weight, colour = "observed"), size = 0.9) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(ggplot2::aes(y = predicted, colour = "curve"), linewidth = 0.6) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(data = lab, ggplot2::aes(label = label),
                       x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.2,
                       size = 2.8, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~responder, ncol = min(ncol, length(lv))) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = y_rng + c(-2, 12)) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
      name = NULL, values = cols, breaks = brk,
      labels = c(observed = "daily median weight", curve = "growth curve",
                 record = "weight record", outlier = "outlier")[brk]
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = paste("Station", loc), x = NULL, y = "Body weight (kg)") +
    ppt_theme()
}

adfi_station_plot <- function(d, lab, lv, cols, labels, ncol) {
  loc <- d$location[1L]
  d <- data.table::copy(d)[, responder := factor(responder, levels = lv)]
  d <- d[, .(date, responder, dfi, dfi_raw, state)]
  lab <- data.table::copy(lab)[, responder := factor(responder, levels = lv)]
  y_max <- max(c(d$dfi, d$dfi_raw), na.rm = TRUE)
  brk <- intersect(names(cols), c("raw", unique(d$state)))
  ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x = date)) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(data = lab, ggplot2::aes(yintercept = adfi),
                        linetype = "dashed", colour = "#666666", alpha = 0.6) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(data = d[!is.na(dfi_raw)],
                        ggplot2::aes(y = dfi_raw, colour = "raw"), size = 0.7) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(data = d[!is.na(dfi)], ggplot2::aes(y = dfi),
                       colour = "#666666", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.5) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(data = d[!is.na(dfi)],
                        ggplot2::aes(y = dfi, colour = state), size = 0.9) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(data = lab, ggplot2::aes(label = label),
                       x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.2,
                       size = 2.8, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~responder, ncol = min(ncol, length(lv))) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min(0, d$dfi_raw, d$dfi, na.rm = TRUE), y_max * 1.25)) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(name = NULL, values = cols, breaks = brk,
                                 labels = labels[brk]) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = paste("Station", loc), x = NULL,
                  y = "Daily feed intake (g)") +
    ppt_theme()
}

filter_pigs <- function(daily, responders, locations) {
  out <- daily
  if (!is.null(responders)) {
    unknown <- setdiff(as.character(responders), out$responder)
    if (length(unknown) > 0L) ppt_warn("Pig{?s} not found: {.val {unknown}}")
    out <- out[responder %in% as.character(responders)]
  }
  if (!is.null(locations)) {
    unknown <- setdiff(as.character(locations), out$location)
    if (length(unknown) > 0L) ppt_warn("Station{?s} not found: {.val {unknown}}")
    out <- out[location %in% as.character(locations)]
  }
  if (nrow(out) == 0L) cli::cli_abort("No data left to plot after filtering.")
  data.table::copy(out)
}

# Numeric IDs sorted as numbers, other IDs alphabetically.
natural_order <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(as.character(x))
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("_.*$", "", x)))
  x[order(is.na(num), num, x)]
}

ppt_theme <- function() {
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2"),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()
    )
}
```

```{r example-plots}
visits <- prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0)
w <- clean_weight(visits, verbose = 0)
adg <- calc_adg(w, verbose = 0)
adfi <- calc_adfi(visits, adg, verbose = 0)

g <- plot_adg(adg, weight = w, locations = "101", responders = c("13913", "13918", "13954"))
g$plot[[1]]

f$plot[[1]]

out <- save_plots(g, path = tempdir(), prefix = "loc", suffix = "growth", device = "pdf")
file.exists(out$file)
unlink(out$file)
```

```{r tests-plots}
plot_inputs <- function(data = fire) {
  v <- prep_visits(data, verbose = 0)
  w <- clean_weight(v, verbose = 0)
  a <- suppressWarnings(calc_adg(w, verbose = 0))
  list(w = w, adg = a, adfi = calc_adfi(v, a, verbose = 0))
}

render_ok <- function(p) {
  f <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf")
  grDevices::pdf(f)
  on.exit({grDevices::dev.off(); unlink(f)})
  print(p)
  TRUE
}

test_that("plot_adg gives one plot per station and renders without warnings", {
  r <- plot_inputs()
  g <- plot_adg(r$adg, weight = r$w, verbose = 0)
  expect_equal(g$location, c("101", "102"))
  expect_true(all(vapply(g$plot, ggplot2::is.ggplot, logical(1))))
  expect_equal(sum(g$n_pigs), nrow(r$adg$per_pig))
  expect_no_warning(render_ok(g$plot[[1]]))
  expect_no_warning(render_ok(plot_adg(r$adg, verbose = 0)$plot[[2]]))
})

test_that("another stage range does not drop points", {
  v <- prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0)
  w <- clean_weight(v, qc = qc_config(stage_range = c(50, 100)), verbose = 0)
  a <- calc_adg(w, verbose = 0)
  g <- plot_adg(a, weight = w, locations = "101", verbose = 0)
  expect_no_warning(render_ok(g$plot[[1]]))
})

test_that("plot_adfi renders and shows the states", {
  r <- plot_inputs()
  f <- plot_adfi(r$adfi, verbose = 0)
  expect_equal(nrow(f), 2L)
  expect_no_warning(render_ok(f$plot[[1]]))
  expect_true(all(f$plot[[1]]$data$in_stage))
})

test_that("filters work and unknown IDs warn", {
  r <- plot_inputs()
  g <- plot_adg(r$adg, responders = c("35853", "35855"), verbose = 0)
  expect_equal(sum(g$n_pigs), 2L)
  expect_message(plot_adg(r$adg, responders = c("35853", "nope"), verbose = 1), "nope")
  expect_error(plot_adg(r$adg, locations = "999", verbose = 0), "No data")
  expect_error(plot_adg(r$adfi), "calc_adg")
})

test_that("plots do not carry the data of other stations", {
  r <- plot_inputs()
  g <- plot_adg(r$adg, weight = r$w, verbose = 0)
  env <- g$plot[[1]]$plot_env
  # the plot's environment holds only this station's records
  expect_false(exists("weight", envir = env, inherits = FALSE))
  expect_setequal(unique(as.character(env$rec$responder)),
                  as.character(r$adg$per_pig[location == g$location[1], responder]))
})

test_that("save_plots in parallel gives the same files", {
  skip_on_os("windows")   # PSOCK needs the installed package
  r <- plot_inputs()
  g <- plot_adfi(r$adfi, verbose = 0)
  dir <- withr::local_tempdir()
  out <- save_plots(g, dir, device = "pdf", verbose = 0, cores = 2)
  expect_true(all(out$saved))
  expect_true(all(file.exists(out$file)))
})

test_that("save_plots writes one file per station", {
  r <- plot_inputs()
  g <- plot_adfi(r$adfi, verbose = 0)
  dir <- withr::local_tempdir()
  out <- save_plots(g, dir, prefix = "loc", suffix = "adfi", device = "pdf", verbose = 0)
  expect_true(all(out$saved))
  expect_true(all(file.exists(out$file)))
  expect_equal(basename(out$file), c("loc_101_adfi.pdf", "loc_102_adfi.pdf"))
  expect_error(save_plots(list(), dir), "plot_adg")
})

test_that("natural_order sorts numeric IDs as numbers", {
  expect_equal(natural_order(c("100", "20", "3", "a", "20_101")),
               c("3", "20", "20_101", "100", "a"))
})
```

# run_pipeline

`run_pipeline()` runs every step with one set of QC settings and keeps all
intermediate results.

```{r function-run_pipeline}
#' Run the Whole Analysis Pipeline
#'
#' @description
#' Run [prep_visits()], [clean_weight()], [calc_adg()], [calc_adfi()] and
#' [calc_fcr()] in a row with the same QC settings.
#'
#' @param data Raw station data (see [prep_visits()]).
#' @param station `"nedap"`, `"fire"` or `NULL` to detect it.
#' @param qc QC settings from [qc_config()].
#' @param breeds Optional breed table passed to [add_breed()] (columns
#'   `responder` and `breed`).
#' @param verbose 0 (silent), 1 (summary, default) or 2 (details).
#' @param cores Number of CPU cores for the per-pig computations. Default 1.
#'
#' @return An object of class `ppt_pipeline`: a list with `visits`,
#'   `weight`, `adg`, `adfi` and `fcr`, plus `removed` (every pig removed,
#'   with the step and the reason).
#' @export
run_pipeline <- function(data, station = NULL, qc = qc_config(), breeds = NULL,
                         verbose = 1, cores = 1) {
  local_verbose(verbose)
  check_qc(qc)
  visits <- prep_visits(data, station = station, qc = qc, verbose = verbose)
  if (!is.null(breeds)) visits <- add_breed(visits, breeds, verbose = verbose)
  weight <- clean_weight(visits, qc = qc, verbose = verbose, cores = cores)
  adg <- calc_adg(weight, qc = qc, verbose = verbose, cores = cores)
  adfi <- calc_adfi(visits, adg, qc = qc, verbose = verbose, cores = cores)
  fcr <- calc_fcr(adg, adfi, verbose = verbose)
  structure(
    list(visits = visits, weight = weight, adg = adg, adfi = adfi, fcr = fcr,
         removed = fcr$removed),
    class = "ppt_pipeline"
  )
}

#' @export
print.ppt_pipeline <- function(x, ...) {
  cli::cli_h2("tidypptsda pipeline ({toupper(attr(x$visits, 'station'))}, profile {.val {attr(x$fcr$settings, 'profile')}})")
  n_id <- data.table::uniqueN(x$visits$responder, na.rm = TRUE)
  p <- x$fcr$per_pig
  cli::cli_bullets(c(
    "*" = "Pigs in the data: {n_id}",
    "*" = "Pigs with weight data kept: {x$weight$per_pig[status != 'removed', .N]}",
    "*" = "Pigs with ADG: {sum(!is.na(x$adg$per_pig$adg))}",
    "*" = "Pigs with FCR: {sum(!is.na(p$fcr))} ({sum(p$fcr_flag %in% 'ok')} ok, {sum(p$fcr_flag %in% 'low_confidence')} low confidence)",
    "*" = "Removed pigs: {data.table::uniqueN(x$removed$responder)} (see {.field $removed})"
  ))
  s <- x$fcr$summary[group == "all" & trait %in% c("adg", "adfi", "fcr")]
  if (nrow(s) > 0L) {
    cli::cli_text("Mean ADG {round(s[trait == 'adg', mean])} g/d, ADFI {round(s[trait == 'adfi', mean])} g/d, FCR {sprintf('%.2f', s[trait == 'fcr', mean])}")
  }
  invisible(x)
}
```

```{r example-run_pipeline}
res <- run_pipeline(fire, qc = qc_config(stage_range = c(60, 120)), verbose = 0)
res
res$fcr$summary[group == "all"]
```

```{r tests-run_pipeline}
test_that("every pig is either analysed or listed with a reason", {
  for (data in list(nedap, fire)) {
    for (p in c("casey", "national", "legacy")) {
      res <- suppressWarnings(run_pipeline(data, qc = qc_config(p), verbose = 0))
      expect_s3_class(res, "ppt_pipeline")
      ids <- unique(stats::na.omit(res$visits$responder))
      with_fcr <- res$fcr$per_pig[!is.na(fcr), responder]
      expect_setequal(union(with_fcr, res$removed$responder), ids)
      expect_true(all(nzchar(res$removed$reason)))
      # each step works on a subset of the previous one
      expect_true(all(res$adg$per_pig$responder %in% res$weight$per_pig$responder))
      expect_true(all(res$fcr$per_pig$responder %in% res$adg$per_pig$responder))
    }
  }
})

test_that("pipeline equals running the steps one by one", {
  qc <- qc_config()
  res <- run_pipeline(nedap, qc = qc, verbose = 0)
  v <- prep_visits(nedap, qc = qc, verbose = 0)
  a <- calc_adg(clean_weight(v, qc, verbose = 0), verbose = 0)
  f <- calc_fcr(a, calc_adfi(v, a, verbose = 0), verbose = 0)
  expect_equal(res$fcr$per_pig, f$per_pig)
})

test_that("print method runs and verbose = 0 is silent", {
  expect_silent(res <- run_pipeline(fire, verbose = 0))
  expect_message(print(res), "FCR")
})
```

# write_results

`write_results()` writes the tables of an analysis to CSV files named
`<farm>_<table>_<date>.csv`, ready to send to the testing station. Files
are UTF-8 with a byte order mark so that Excel shows Chinese text correctly.

```{r function-write_results}
#' Write Analysis Results to CSV Files
#'
#' @description
#' Write the result tables of [run_pipeline()] (or of a single step such as
#' [calc_fcr()]) to CSV files.
#'
#' @param x Result of [run_pipeline()], or of [clean_weight()],
#'   [calc_adg()], [calc_adfi()] or [calc_fcr()].
#' @param dir Folder to write to (created if needed). Default: working
#'   directory.
#' @param farm Farm or station code used as file name prefix.
#' @param date Date in the file names. Default: today.
#' @param bom Write a UTF-8 byte order mark (for Excel). Default `TRUE`.
#' @param verbose 0 (silent), 1 (summary, default).
#'
#' @details
#' For a [run_pipeline()] result the files are:
#' - `fcr`: one row per pig with ADG, ADFI, FCR and confidence flags;
#' - `by_bin`: feed, gain and FCR per body weight class;
#' - `daily_feed`: daily feed intake (recorded, corrected, imputed);
#' - `daily_weight`: daily body weight (recorded and fitted);
#' - `weight_pigs`: weight checks of every pig;
#' - `feed_model`: coefficients of the feed intake correction model;
#' - `removed`: removed pigs with step and reason;
#' - `settings`: the QC settings used.
#'
#' For a single step, its `per_pig`, `daily` and `removed` tables (and
#' `by_bin`, `model` or `summary` when present) are written.
#'
#' @return Invisibly, a `data.table` with `table`, `file` and `rows`.
#' @export
write_results <- function(x, dir = ".", farm = "farm", date = Sys.Date(),
                          bom = TRUE, verbose = 1) {
  local_verbose(verbose)
  if (!is.character(farm) || length(farm) != 1L || !nzchar(farm)) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg farm} must be a single non-empty string.")
  }
  tables <- if (inherits(x, "ppt_pipeline")) {
    list(fcr = x$fcr$per_pig, by_bin = x$fcr$by_bin, daily_feed = x$adfi$daily,
         daily_weight = x$adg$daily, weight_pigs = x$weight$per_pig,
         feed_model = x$adfi$model, summary = x$fcr$summary,
         removed = x$removed, settings = settings_table(x$fcr$settings))
  } else if (inherits(x, "ppt_result")) {
    keep <- intersect(c("per_pig", "daily", "by_bin", "summary", "model", "removed"), names(x))
    c(x[keep], list(settings = settings_table(x$settings)))
  } else {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg x} must be the result of {.fn run_pipeline} or of a {.code calc_*} function.")
  }
  tables <- tables[!vapply(tables, is.null, logical(1))]
  dir.create(dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  stamp <- format(as.Date(date), "%Y%m%d")
  out <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(names(tables), function(nm) {
    file <- file.path(dir, sprintf("%s_%s_%s.csv", farm, nm, stamp))
    data.table::fwrite(tables[[nm]], file, bom = bom)
    data.table::data.table(table = nm, file = file, rows = nrow(tables[[nm]]))
  }))
  ppt_msg("Wrote {nrow(out)} file{?s} to {.path {dir}}", "success")
  invisible(out)
}

# QC settings as a two-column table.
settings_table <- function(qc) {
  if (is.null(qc)) return(NULL)
  val <- vapply(names(qc), function(nm) {
    v <- qc[[nm]]
    if (is.null(v)) "NULL" else if (is.data.frame(v)) sprintf("table (%d rows)", nrow(v)) else paste(v, collapse = ", ")
  }, character(1))
  data.table::data.table(parameter = c("profile", names(qc)),
                         value = c(attr(qc, "profile") %||% "", unname(val)))
}
```

```{r example-write_results}
res <- run_pipeline(nedap, verbose = 0)
out <- write_results(res, dir = file.path(tempdir(), "results"), farm = "demo")
out
unlink(file.path(tempdir(), "results"), recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r tests-write_results}
test_that("write_results writes every table of a pipeline", {
  res <- run_pipeline(fire, qc = qc_config(stage_range = c(60, 120)), verbose = 0)
  dir <- withr::local_tempdir()
  out <- write_results(res, dir, farm = "A01", date = as.Date("2026-10-21"), verbose = 0)
  expect_true(all(file.exists(out$file)))
  expect_true("A01_fcr_20261021.csv" %in% basename(out$file))
  expect_setequal(out$table, c("fcr", "by_bin", "daily_feed", "daily_weight", "weight_pigs",
                               "feed_model", "summary", "removed", "settings"))
  fcr <- data.table::fread(out[table == "fcr", file])
  expect_equal(nrow(fcr), nrow(res$fcr$per_pig))
  st <- data.table::fread(out[table == "settings", file])
  expect_equal(st[parameter == "stage_range", value], "60, 120")
  # BOM for Excel
  expect_equal(readBin(out$file[1], "raw", 3), as.raw(c(0xef, 0xbb, 0xbf)))
})

test_that("write_results works for a single step and rejects other input", {
  v <- prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0)
  w <- clean_weight(v, verbose = 0)
  dir <- withr::local_tempdir()
  out <- write_results(w, dir, farm = "x", verbose = 0)
  expect_setequal(out$table, c("per_pig", "daily", "removed", "settings"))
  expect_error(write_results(list(), dir), "run_pipeline")
  expect_error(write_results(w, dir, farm = ""), "farm")
})
```
